	fmt.Println("\n[TEST GROUP 2] Model Capsule & Checkpoint Serialization")
	modelPath := filepath.Join("samples", "gpu", "test_model.json")
	modelBytes, err := os.ReadFile(modelPath)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Printf(" [FAIL] Could not read %s: %v\n", modelPath, err)
		allPassed = false
	} else {
		var modelMap map[string]any
		if err := json.Unmarshal(modelBytes, &modelMap); err != nil {
			fmt.Printf(" [FAIL] Could not parse %s as JSON: %v\n", modelPath, err)
			allPassed = false
		} else {
			fmt.Printf("  -> [PASS] %s: Valid JSON capsule parsed. Model: %v, Layer: %v, InputShape: %v\n",
				modelPath, modelMap["model_name"], modelMap["layer_type"], modelMap["input_shape"])

			// Test saving and loading a checkpoint
			tmpDir, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "sample-onnx-test-*")
			if err != nil {
				fmt.Printf(" [FAIL] Could not create temp dir: %v\n", err)
				allPassed = false
			} else {
				defer os.RemoveAll(tmpDir)
				ckptPath := filepath.Join(tmpDir, "sample_checkpoint.ckpt")
				ckpt := onnx.Checkpoint{
					JobID:        "test-job-sample",
					Step:         10,
					Loss:         0.42,
					LearningRate: 0.001,
					Weights: map[string][]float32{
						"w1": {0.1, 0.2, -0.3, 0.4},
						"b1": {0.01, 0.02},
					},
				}
				hashHex, err := onnx.SaveCheckpoint(ckpt, ckptPath)
				if err != nil {
					fmt.Printf(" [FAIL] SaveCheckpoint failed: %v\n", err)
					allPassed = false
				} else {
					fmt.Printf("  -> [PASS] Checkpoint saved: Step=%d, SHA256=%s\n", ckpt.Step, hashHex[:16]+"...")

					loaded, err := onnx.LoadCheckpoint(ckptPath)
					if err != nil || loaded.SHA256Checksum != hashHex {
						fmt.Printf(" [FAIL] LoadCheckpoint failed or hash mismatch: %v\n", err)
						allPassed = false
					} else {
						fmt.Println("  -> [PASS] Checkpoint integrity verified successfully.")
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	// 2. Test Code Execution Protocol Encapsulation on Objective 2 Samples
	if !*runDocker {
		fmt.Println("\n[TEST GROUP 3] Container Code Execution (Wire Protocol Round-Trip Only)")
	} else {
		fmt.Println("\n[TEST GROUP 3] Container Code Execution (Live Docker Execution)")
	}

	var dockerExec *codeexec.DockerExecutor
	if *runDocker {
		if _, err := exec.LookPath("docker"); err != nil {
			fmt.Printf(" [FAIL] docker CLI binary not found on PATH: %v\n", err)
			allPassed = false
		} else {
			dockerExec = codeexec.NewDockerExecutor(codeexec.Config{MaxConcurrent: 2})
		}
	}

	codeSamples := []struct {
		name string
		lang string
		path string
	}{
		{"calc.py", "python", filepath.Join("samples", "python", "calc.py")},
		{"hello.c", "c", filepath.Join("samples", "c", "hello.c")},
		{"fib.cpp", "cpp", filepath.Join("samples", "cpp", "fib.cpp")},
		{"timeout_test.py", "python", filepath.Join("samples", "security", "timeout_test.py")},
		{"network_leak_test.py", "python", filepath.Join("samples", "security", "network_leak_test.py")},
		{"mem_limit_test.py", "python", filepath.Join("samples", "security", "mem_limit_test.py")},
	}

	for _, sample := range codeSamples {
		src, err := os.ReadFile(sample.path)
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Printf(" [FAIL] Could not read %s: %v\n", sample.path, err)
			allPassed = false
			continue
		}

		req := codeexec.Request{
			JobID:          "verify-" + sample.name,
			Language:       sample.lang,
			Source:         string(src),
			TimeoutSeconds: 10,
		}

		encoded, err := codeexec.EncodeRequest(req)
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Printf(" [FAIL] EncodeRequest failed for %s: %v\n", sample.name, err)
			allPassed = false
			continue
		}

		decoded, err := codeexec.DecodeRequest(encoded)
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Printf(" [FAIL] DecodeRequest failed for %s: %v\n", sample.name, err)
			allPassed = false
			continue
		}

		if decoded.JobID != req.JobID || decoded.Language != strings.ToLower(req.Language) || len(decoded.Source) != len(req.Source) {
			fmt.Printf(" [FAIL] Round-trip mismatch for %s\n", sample.name)
			allPassed = false
			continue
		}

		if dockerExec != nil {
			res := dockerExec.Execute(context.Background(), req)
			fmt.Printf("  -> [PASS] %s (%s, %d bytes): Live container execution completed (exit=%d, time=%dms, err=%v)\n",
				sample.name, sample.lang, len(src), res.ExitCode, res.DurationMs, res.Error)
		} else {
			fmt.Printf("  -> [PASS] %s (%s, %d bytes): Wire protocol encode/decode verified.\n",
				sample.name, sample.lang, len(src))
		}
	}

	fmt.Println("\n=======================================================================")
	if allPassed {
		fmt.Println(" [SUCCESS] All standalone sample verifications passed!")
	} else {
		fmt.Println(" [FAILURE] One or more standalone sample verifications failed.")
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Println("=======================================================================")
}

package main

import (
	"crypto/rand"
	"encoding/hex"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"strings"
	"syscall"

	"github.com/unicompute/obj1/pkg/relay"
	"github.com/unicompute/obj1/pkg/signaling"
)

func getEnv(key, fallback string) string {
	if val := os.Getenv(key); val != "" {
		return val
	}
	return fallback
}

func main() {
	defaultListen := "0.0.0.0:8080"
	if p := os.Getenv("PORT"); p != "" {
		defaultListen = "0.0.0.0:" + p
	}
	defaultListen = getEnv("UNICOMPUTE_LISTEN", defaultListen)
	defaultPublicIP := getEnv("UNICOMPUTE_PUBLIC_IP", "127.0.0.1")
	defaultRealm := getEnv("UNICOMPUTE_REALM", "unicompute.edu")
	turnSecret := getEnv("UNICOMPUTE_TURN_SECRET", "")
	defaultEnableTURN := true
	if os.Getenv("UNICOMPUTE_TURN") == "false" || os.Getenv("ENABLE_TURN") == "false" {
		defaultEnableTURN = false
	}

	listenAddr := flag.String("listen", defaultListen, "Signaling server listen address")
	enableTURN := flag.Bool("turn", defaultEnableTURN, "Enable embedded TURN server")
	turnPort := flag.Int("turn-port", 3478, "Embedded TURN UDP port")
	turnRealm := flag.String("realm", defaultRealm, "TURN authentication realm")
	publicIP := flag.String("public-ip", defaultPublicIP, "Public IP for TURN relay")
	authToken := flag.String("auth-token", os.Getenv("UNICOMPUTE_AUTH_TOKEN"), "Cluster auth secret token")
	insecureNoAuth := flag.Bool("insecure-no-auth", false, "Disable authentication for local dev")

	flag.Parse()

	isLoopback := strings.HasPrefix(*listenAddr, "127.0.0.1:") || strings.HasPrefix(*listenAddr, "localhost:") || strings.HasPrefix(*listenAddr, "[::1]:")
	if *authToken == "" && !*insecureNoAuth && !isLoopback {
		tokenBytes := make([]byte, 32)
		if _, err := rand.Read(tokenBytes); err == nil {
			*authToken = hex.EncodeToString(tokenBytes)
			log.Printf("[SECURITY] Generated random cluster auth token: %s\n", *authToken)
		}
	}

	fmt.Println("===================================================================")
	fmt.Println(" UniCompute Signaling Hub & Coordinator Control Plane")
	fmt.Printf(" Listening on:  %s\n", *listenAddr)
	fmt.Printf(" Public IP:     %s\n", *publicIP)
	fmt.Printf(" Embedded TURN: %v (UDP :%d, Realm: %s)\n", *enableTURN, *turnPort, *turnRealm)
	if *authToken != "" {
		fmt.Printf(" Auth Token:    [CONFIGURED]\n")
	} else {
		fmt.Printf(" Auth Token:    [DISABLED / INSECURE]\n")
	}
	fmt.Println(" Invariant CP-1: Control Plane is decoupled from Data Plane")
	fmt.Println("===================================================================")

	hub, err := signaling.NewHub(*listenAddr, *authToken)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("[FATAL] Failed to start signaling hub: %v\n", err)
	}
	defer hub.Close()

	log.Printf("[INFO] Signaling WebSocket ready at %s\n", hub.URL())
	log.Printf("[INFO] Health check available at http://%s/health\n", *listenAddr)
	log.Printf("[INFO] Online nodes API at http://%s/api/nodes\n", *listenAddr)

	if *enableTURN {
		turnUser := os.Getenv("UNICOMPUTE_TURN_USER")
		turnPass := os.Getenv("UNICOMPUTE_TURN_PASS")
		users := make(map[string]string)
		if turnUser != "" && turnPass != "" {
			users[turnUser] = turnPass
		}

		if turnSecret == "" && len(users) == 0 {
			log.Println("[WARN] Embedded TURN enabled without credentials (set UNICOMPUTE_TURN_USER/UNICOMPUTE_TURN_PASS or UNICOMPUTE_TURN_SECRET). Skipping TURN startup.")
		} else {
			turnSrv, err := relay.NewEmbeddedTURN(relay.TURNConfig{
				Port:     *turnPort,
				Realm:    *turnRealm,
				PublicIP: *publicIP,
				Secret:   turnSecret,
				Users:    users,
			})
			if err != nil {
				log.Printf("[WARN] Failed to start embedded TURN: %v\n", err)
			} else {
				defer turnSrv.Close()
				log.Printf("[INFO] Embedded TURN server listening on UDP %s\n", turnSrv.Addr())
			}
		}
	}

	sigCh := make(chan os.Signal, 1)
	signal.Notify(sigCh, os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
	<-sigCh

	log.Println("[INFO] Shutting down signaling hub...")
}

package main

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"crypto/subtle"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/gorilla/websocket"
	"github.com/unicompute/obj1/pkg/codeexec"
	"github.com/unicompute/obj1/pkg/gpu"
	"github.com/unicompute/obj1/pkg/nat"
	"github.com/unicompute/obj1/pkg/node"
	"github.com/unicompute/obj1/pkg/remoteshell"
)

type wsClient struct {
	conn    *websocket.Conn
	writeMu sync.Mutex
}

// ServerState encapsulates the active node and GUI runtime state.
type ServerState struct {
	mu             sync.RWMutex
	node           *node.Node
	nodeConfig     node.NodeConfig
	gpuEnabled     bool
	gpuConfig      gpu.ManagerConfig
	coordinatorURL string
	sessionToken   string
	activePort     int
	upgrader       websocket.Upgrader
	wsClients      map[*wsClient]bool
	wsMu           sync.Mutex
	eventLog       []EventMessage
	pendingReqs    map[string]string // peerID -> status
	pendingPings   map[string]chan time.Duration
	pingMu         sync.Mutex
	startTime      time.Time
	relayThreshold float64
	joinToken      string
	allowRemoteGUI bool
	tasksMu        sync.RWMutex
	tasks          []ClusterTask
}

// ClusterTask represents a DAG / ClassAd scheduled cluster task.
type ClusterTask struct {
	JobID       string `json:"job_id"`
	ClassAd     string `json:"class_ad"`
	TargetMatch string `json:"target_match"`
	StageDAG    string `json:"stage_dag"`
	Priority    string `json:"priority"`
	Status      string `json:"status"`
	DurationMs  int64  `json:"duration_ms,omitempty"`
	Timestamp   string `json:"timestamp"`
}

// EventMessage represents a real-time event sent to the GUI.
type EventMessage struct {
	Timestamp time.Time `json:"timestamp"`
	Type      string    `json:"type"`
	PeerID    string    `json:"peer_id,omitempty"`
	Message   string    `json:"message"`
	Payload   any       `json:"payload,omitempty"`
}

func shortID(id string, n int) string {
	if len(id) <= n {
		return id
	}
	return id[:n]
}

func (s *ServerState) SessionToken() string {
	s.mu.RLock()
	defer s.mu.RUnlock()
	return s.sessionToken
}

func (s *ServerState) SetSessionToken(token string) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	s.sessionToken = token
}

func (s *ServerState) SetActivePort(port int) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	s.activePort = port
}

func (s *ServerState) SetAllowRemoteGUI(allow bool) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	s.allowRemoteGUI = allow
}

func (s *ServerState) isAllowedOrigin(r *http.Request) bool {
	origin := r.Header.Get("Origin")
	if origin == "" {
		return true
	}
	u, err := url.Parse(origin)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	s.mu.RLock()
	allowRemote := s.allowRemoteGUI
	expectedPort := s.activePort
	s.mu.RUnlock()

	host := u.Hostname()
	port := u.Port()

	isLoopback := host == "127.0.0.1" || host == "localhost" || host == "::1"
	portMatches := (expectedPort == 0 || port == "" || port == fmt.Sprintf("%d", expectedPort))

	if !allowRemote {
		return isLoopback && portMatches
	}

	if isLoopback && portMatches {
		return true
	}
	if r.Host != "" && u.Host == r.Host {
		return true
	}
	return false
}

func NewServerState(n *node.Node, nCfg node.NodeConfig, gpuEnabled bool, gCfg gpu.ManagerConfig) *ServerState {
	tokenBytes := make([]byte, 32)
	_, _ = rand.Read(tokenBytes)

	joinBytes := make([]byte, 4)
	_, _ = rand.Read(joinBytes)
	initJoinToken := fmt.Sprintf("UC-%04X-%04X", binary.BigEndian.Uint16(joinBytes[0:2]), binary.BigEndian.Uint16(joinBytes[2:4]))

	s := &ServerState{
		node:           n,
		nodeConfig:     nCfg,
		gpuEnabled:     gpuEnabled,
		gpuConfig:      gCfg,
		coordinatorURL: nCfg.SignalingURL,
		sessionToken:   hex.EncodeToString(tokenBytes),
		startTime:      time.Now(),
		relayThreshold: 2.0,
		joinToken:      initJoinToken,
		wsClients:      make(map[*wsClient]bool),
		eventLog:       make([]EventMessage, 0, 100),
		pendingReqs:    make(map[string]string),
		pendingPings:   make(map[string]chan time.Duration),
		tasks:          []ClusterTask{}, // Real empty task queue; no fake seed tasks
	}

	s.upgrader = websocket.Upgrader{
		CheckOrigin: func(r *http.Request) bool {
			return s.isAllowedOrigin(r)
		},
	}

	// Register event hooks from node
	n.SetOnFleetPeerJoined(func(peerID string) {
		s.Broadcast("fleet_peer_joined", peerID, fmt.Sprintf("Peer '%s' registered with coordinator", peerID), nil)
	})

	n.SetOnFleetPeerLeft(func(peerID string) {
		s.Broadcast("fleet_peer_left", peerID, fmt.Sprintf("Peer '%s' disconnected from coordinator", peerID), nil)
	})

	n.SetOnPeerConnected(func(peerID string) {
		metrics, _ := n.GetPathMetrics(peerID)
		s.Broadcast("peer_connected", peerID, fmt.Sprintf("P2P WebRTC DataChannel established with '%s'", peerID), metrics)
	})

	n.SetOnPeerDisconnected(func(peerID string) {
		s.Broadcast("peer_disconnected", peerID, fmt.Sprintf("P2P link closed with '%s'", peerID), nil)
	})

	n.SetOnStreamMessage(func(peerID string, data []byte) {
		msg := string(data)
		if strings.HasPrefix(msg, "__PING__:") {
			ts := strings.TrimPrefix(msg, "__PING__:")
			_ = n.SendStream(peerID, []byte("__PONG__:"+ts))
			return
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(msg, "__PONG__:") {
			parts := strings.Split(strings.TrimPrefix(msg, "__PONG__:"), ":")
			if len(parts) >= 2 {
				pingID := parts[1]
				s.pingMu.Lock()
				ch, ok := s.pendingPings[pingID]
				s.pingMu.Unlock()
				if ok && ch != nil {
					if tsNano, err := strconv.ParseInt(parts[0], 10, 64); err == nil {
						rtt := time.Duration(time.Now().UnixNano() - tsNano)
						n.RecordPeerRTT(peerID, rtt)
						select {
						case ch <- rtt:
						default:
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return
		}
		s.Broadcast("stream_message", peerID, msg, map[string]string{"from": peerID, "text": msg})
	})

	n.SetOnChunkReceived(func(peerID, chunkID string, size int64) {
		s.Broadcast("chunk_received", peerID, fmt.Sprintf("Received chunk %s (%d bytes) from %s", shortID(chunkID, 8), size, peerID), map[string]any{
			"chunk_id": chunkID,
			"size":     size,
		})
	})

	return s
}

// addTask prepends a new task to the global cluster task queue.
func (s *ServerState) addTask(task ClusterTask) {
	s.tasksMu.Lock()
	s.tasks = append([]ClusterTask{task}, s.tasks...)
	if len(s.tasks) > 50 {
		s.tasks = s.tasks[:50]
	}
	s.tasksMu.Unlock()
	s.Broadcast("task_dispatched", "", fmt.Sprintf("Cluster task %s updated: %s", task.JobID, task.Status), task)
}

// Broadcast dispatches an event to all connected GUI browser/desktop windows.
func (s *ServerState) Broadcast(eventType, peerID, message string, payload any) {
	evt := EventMessage{
		Timestamp: time.Now(),
		Type:      eventType,
		PeerID:    peerID,
		Message:   message,
		Payload:   payload,
	}

	s.wsMu.Lock()
	if len(s.eventLog) >= 200 {
		s.eventLog = s.eventLog[1:]
	}
	s.eventLog = append(s.eventLog, evt)

	clients := make([]*wsClient, 0, len(s.wsClients))
	for client := range s.wsClients {
		clients = append(clients, client)
	}
	s.wsMu.Unlock()

	for _, client := range clients {
		client.writeMu.Lock()
		_ = client.conn.SetWriteDeadline(time.Now().Add(2 * time.Second))
		err := client.conn.WriteJSON(evt)
		client.writeMu.Unlock()

		if err != nil {
			s.wsMu.Lock()
			delete(s.wsClients, client)
			s.wsMu.Unlock()
			_ = client.conn.Close()
		}
	}
}

// authMiddleware enforces Origin checks, constant-time bearer token auth, and Content-Type validation.
func (s *ServerState) authMiddleware(next http.HandlerFunc) http.HandlerFunc {
	return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		// 1. Origin header validation (if present)
		if !s.isAllowedOrigin(r) {
			http.Error(w, "forbidden origin", http.StatusForbidden)
			return
		}

		// 2. Token validation (Authorization: Bearer <token> or ?token=<token>)
		s.mu.RLock()
		expectedToken := s.sessionToken
		s.mu.RUnlock()

		if expectedToken != "" {
			token := ""
			authHdr := r.Header.Get("Authorization")
			if strings.HasPrefix(authHdr, "Bearer ") {
				token = strings.TrimPrefix(authHdr, "Bearer ")
			} else {
				token = r.URL.Query().Get("token")
			}

			if token == "" || subtle.ConstantTimeCompare([]byte(token), []byte(expectedToken)) != 1 {
				http.Error(w, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
				return
			}
		}

		// 3. Content-Type validation for mutating requests (POST, PUT, DELETE)
		if r.Method == http.MethodPost || r.Method == http.MethodPut || r.Method == http.MethodDelete {
			ct := r.Header.Get("Content-Type")
			if !strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(ct), "application/json") {
				http.Error(w, "unsupported media type: application/json required", http.StatusUnsupportedMediaType)
				return
			}
		}

		next(w, r)
	}
}

// SetupRoutes registers all REST and WebSocket API endpoints wrapped in auth middleware.
func (s *ServerState) SetupRoutes(mux *http.ServeMux) {
	mux.HandleFunc("/api/status", s.authMiddleware(s.handleStatus))
	mux.HandleFunc("/api/coordinator/connect", s.authMiddleware(s.handleCoordinatorConnect))
	mux.HandleFunc("/api/coordinator/status", s.authMiddleware(s.handleCoordinatorStatus))
	mux.HandleFunc("/api/coordinator/settings", s.authMiddleware(s.handleCoordinatorSettings))
	mux.HandleFunc("/api/tasks", s.authMiddleware(s.handleTasks))
	mux.HandleFunc("/api/fleet", s.authMiddleware(s.handleFleet))
	mux.HandleFunc("/api/peers", s.authMiddleware(s.handlePeers))
	mux.HandleFunc("/api/peer/connect", s.authMiddleware(s.handlePeerConnect))
	mux.HandleFunc("/api/peer/disconnect", s.authMiddleware(s.handlePeerDisconnect))
	mux.HandleFunc("/api/peer/ping", s.authMiddleware(s.handlePeerPing))
	mux.HandleFunc("/api/peer/stream", s.authMiddleware(s.handlePeerStream))
	mux.HandleFunc("/api/gpu", s.authMiddleware(s.handleGPU))
	mux.HandleFunc("/api/gpu/hipify", s.authMiddleware(s.handleGPUHipify))
	mux.HandleFunc("/api/gpu/run", s.authMiddleware(s.handleGPURun))
	mux.HandleFunc("/api/code/run", s.authMiddleware(s.handleCodeRun))
	mux.HandleFunc("/api/shell/exec", s.authMiddleware(s.handleShellExec))
	mux.HandleFunc("/api/storage/blobs", s.authMiddleware(s.handleStorageBlobs))
	mux.HandleFunc("/api/storage/get", s.authMiddleware(s.handleStorageGet))
	mux.HandleFunc("/api/storage/put", s.authMiddleware(s.handleStoragePut))
	mux.HandleFunc("/api/storage/del", s.authMiddleware(s.handleStorageDel))
	mux.HandleFunc("/api/storage/scrub", s.authMiddleware(s.handleStorageScrub))
	mux.HandleFunc("/api/samples", s.authMiddleware(s.handleSamples))
	mux.HandleFunc("/api/events", s.authMiddleware(s.handleEventsWS))
}

func writeJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, data any) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(data)
}

func (s *ServerState) handleStatus(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	s.mu.RLock()
	coordURL := s.coordinatorURL
	joinToken := s.joinToken
	nodeID := s.nodeConfig.NodeID
	poolID := s.nodeConfig.PoolID
	s.mu.RUnlock()

	usage := s.node.StorageUsage()
	natRep := s.node.NATReport()
	if natRep == nil {
		natRep = &nat.NATReport{NATType: nat.NATTypeUnknown}
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 1*time.Second)
	fleet, _ := s.node.GetFleetNodes(ctx)
	cancel()
	peers := s.node.GetConnectedPeers()

	gpuProf, gpuActive := s.node.GPUProfile()
	wdStat, _ := s.node.GPUWatchdogStatus()

	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"node_id":          nodeID,
		"pool_id":          poolID,
		"coordinator_url":  coordURL,
		"join_token":       joinToken,
		"storage":          usage,
		"nat":              natRep,
		"fleet_count":      len(fleet),
		"peer_count":       len(peers),
		"gpu_enabled":      gpuActive,
		"gpu_profile":      gpuProf,
		"watchdog":         wdStat,
		"os":               runtime.GOOS,
		"arch":             runtime.GOARCH,
		"cpus":             runtime.NumCPU(),
		"go_version":       runtime.Version(),
		"docker_available": s.node.HasCodeExecutor(),
	})
}

func (s *ServerState) handleCoordinatorConnect(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	r.Body = http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 2<<20)
	var body struct {
		URL string `json:"url"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil || body.URL == "" {
		http.Error(w, "invalid coordinator url", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	url := strings.TrimSpace(body.URL)
	s.mu.Lock()
	s.coordinatorURL = url
	s.mu.Unlock()

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	_ = s.node.ReconnectSignaling(ctx, url)

	s.Broadcast("coordinator_reconnect", "", fmt.Sprintf("Connecting to coordinator: %s", url), body.URL)
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"status": "reconnecting", "url": url})
}

func (s *ServerState) handleCoordinatorStatus(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	s.mu.RLock()
	coordURL := s.coordinatorURL
	startTime := s.startTime
	relayThreshold := s.relayThreshold
	joinToken := s.joinToken
	authToken := s.nodeConfig.AuthToken
	s.mu.RUnlock()

	httpURL := coordURL
	if strings.HasPrefix(httpURL, "wss://") {
		httpURL = "https://" + strings.TrimPrefix(httpURL, "wss://")
	} else if strings.HasPrefix(httpURL, "ws://") {
		httpURL = "http://" + strings.TrimPrefix(httpURL, "ws://")
	}
	httpURL = strings.TrimSuffix(httpURL, "/ws")

	client := &http.Client{Timeout: 1200 * time.Millisecond}
	status := "RUNNING"
	fleetCount := 0
	nodeIDs := []string{}

	// Query coordinator /health
	healthResp, err := client.Get(httpURL + "/health")
	if err == nil && healthResp.StatusCode == http.StatusOK {
		healthResp.Body.Close()
		// Health succeeded; query coordinator /api/nodes
		req, err := http.NewRequest("GET", httpURL+"/api/nodes", nil)
		if err == nil {
			if authToken != "" {
				req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+authToken)
			}
			nodesResp, err := client.Do(req)
			if err == nil && nodesResp.StatusCode == http.StatusOK {
				defer nodesResp.Body.Close()
				var nData struct {
					Count int      `json:"count"`
					Nodes []string `json:"nodes"`
				}
				if json.NewDecoder(nodesResp.Body).Decode(&nData) == nil {
					fleetCount = nData.Count
					nodeIDs = nData.Nodes
				}
			} else if nodesResp != nil {
				nodesResp.Body.Close()
			}
		}
	} else {
		if healthResp != nil {
			healthResp.Body.Close()
		}
		// Remote HTTP probe failed or timed out; check locally cached fleet with fast timeout
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 500*time.Millisecond)
		fleet, fErr := s.node.GetFleetNodes(ctx)
		cancel()
		if fErr == nil && len(fleet) > 0 {
			fleetCount = len(fleet)
			nodeIDs = fleet
			status = "CONNECTED"
		} else {
			status = "DISCONNECTED"
			fleetCount = 0
			nodeIDs = []string{}
		}
	}

	connectedPeers := s.node.GetConnectedPeers()
	directCount := 0
	relayedCount := 0
	var totalDirectRTT int64
	directNodes := []string{}
	relayedNodes := []string{}

	for _, p := range connectedPeers {
		if m, ok := s.node.GetPathMetrics(p); ok && m.IsDirect {
			directCount++
			directNodes = append(directNodes, p)
			totalDirectRTT += m.RTT.Milliseconds()
		} else {
			relayedCount++
			relayedNodes = append(relayedNodes, p)
		}
	}

	avgRTT := 0.0
	if directCount > 0 {
		avgRTT = float64(totalDirectRTT) / float64(directCount)
	}

	uptimeDur := time.Since(startTime)
	uptimeStr := fmt.Sprintf("%dh %02dm %02ds", int(uptimeDur.Hours()), int(uptimeDur.Minutes())%60, int(uptimeDur.Seconds())%60)

	usage := s.node.StorageUsage()
	natRep := s.node.NATReport()
	natType := "Unknown"
	if natRep != nil {
		natType = string(natRep.NATType)
	}

	coordHost := ""
	if u, err := url.Parse(coordURL); err == nil && u.Host != "" {
		coordHost = u.Host
	} else {
		trimmed := strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimPrefix(coordURL, "wss://"), "ws://")
		if idx := strings.Index(trimmed, "/"); idx != -1 {
			coordHost = trimmed[:idx]
		} else {
			coordHost = trimmed
		}
	}

	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"status":              status,
		"uptime":              uptimeStr,
		"coordinator_url":     coordURL,
		"coordinator_host":    coordHost,
		"http_url":            httpURL,
		"transport":           "WebRTC DataChannel (ICE/DTLS/SCTP)",
		"blob_count":          usage.BlobCount,
		"storage_bytes":       usage.UsedBytes,
		"nat_type":            natType,
		"fleet_count":         fleetCount,
		"node_ids":            nodeIDs,
		"join_token":          joinToken,
		"relay_threshold":     relayThreshold,
		"avg_rtt_ms":          avgRTT,
		"direct_peers_count":  directCount,
		"relayed_peers_count": relayedCount,
		"direct_nodes":        directNodes,
		"relayed_nodes":       relayedNodes,
		"throttled_count":     0,
	})
}

func (s *ServerState) handleCoordinatorSettings(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method == http.MethodPost {
		r.Body = http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 2<<20)
		var body struct {
			RelayThreshold *float64 `json:"relay_threshold"`
			RotateToken    bool     `json:"rotate_token"`
			JoinToken      string   `json:"join_token"`
		}
		if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil {
			http.Error(w, "invalid settings payload: "+err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
			return
		}

		s.mu.Lock()
		if body.RelayThreshold != nil {
			val := *body.RelayThreshold
			if val < 0.5 || val > 5.0 {
				s.mu.Unlock()
				http.Error(w, "relay_threshold must be between 0.5 and 5.0", http.StatusBadRequest)
				return
			}
			s.relayThreshold = val
			s.node.SetFallbackTimeout(time.Duration(val * float64(time.Second)))
		}
		if body.RotateToken {
			u := uuid.New()
			s.joinToken = fmt.Sprintf("UC-%02X%02X-%02X%02X", u[0], u[1], u[2], u[3])
		} else if body.JoinToken != "" {
			s.joinToken = strings.TrimSpace(body.JoinToken)
		}
		thresh := s.relayThreshold
		token := s.joinToken
		s.mu.Unlock()

		s.Broadcast("coordinator_settings_updated", "", fmt.Sprintf("Relay threshold set to %.1fs", thresh), map[string]any{
			"relay_threshold": thresh,
			"join_token":      token,
		})
	}

	s.mu.RLock()
	thresh := s.relayThreshold
	token := s.joinToken
	s.mu.RUnlock()

	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"relay_threshold": thresh,
		"join_token":      token,
	})
}

func (s *ServerState) handleTasks(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method == http.MethodPost {
		r.Body = http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 2<<20)
		var body ClusterTask
		if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil {
			http.Error(w, "invalid task payload: "+err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
			return
		}
		if body.JobID == "" {
			s.tasksMu.RLock()
			taskCount := len(s.tasks)
			s.tasksMu.RUnlock()
			body.JobID = fmt.Sprintf("#JOB-%d", 8100+taskCount+1)
		}
		if body.Timestamp == "" {
			body.Timestamp = time.Now().Format("15:04:05")
		}
		s.addTask(body)
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, body)
		return
	}

	s.tasksMu.RLock()
	tasksCopy := make([]ClusterTask, len(s.tasks))
	copy(tasksCopy, s.tasks)
	s.tasksMu.RUnlock()

	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"tasks": tasksCopy,
		"count": len(tasksCopy),
	})
}

func (s *ServerState) handleFleet(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()

	fleet, err := s.node.GetFleetNodes(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"nodes": []string{}})
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"nodes": fleet})
}

func (s *ServerState) handlePeers(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	connectedPeers := s.node.GetConnectedPeers()
	type PeerMetrics struct {
		IsDirect        bool    `json:"is_direct"`
		RTTMs           float64 `json:"rtt_ms"`
		LocalCandidate  string  `json:"local_candidate,omitempty"`
		RemoteCandidate string  `json:"remote_candidate,omitempty"`
		PairType        string  `json:"pair_type,omitempty"`
		BytesSent       int64   `json:"bytes_sent"`
		BytesReceived   int64   `json:"bytes_received"`
	}
	type PeerInfo struct {
		PeerID   string       `json:"peer_id"`
		IsDirect bool         `json:"is_direct"`
		Metrics  *PeerMetrics `json:"metrics,omitempty"`
	}

	result := make([]PeerInfo, 0, len(connectedPeers))
	for _, p := range connectedPeers {
		info := PeerInfo{PeerID: p}
		if m, ok := s.node.GetPathMetrics(p); ok {
			rttMs := float64(m.RTT.Microseconds()) / 1000.0
			info.IsDirect = m.IsDirect
			info.Metrics = &PeerMetrics{
				IsDirect:        m.IsDirect,
				RTTMs:           rttMs,
				LocalCandidate:  m.LocalCandidate,
				RemoteCandidate: m.RemoteCandidate,
				PairType:        string(m.PairType),
				BytesSent:       m.BytesSent,
				BytesReceived:   m.BytesReceived,
			}
		}
		result = append(result, info)
	}

	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"peers": result})
}

func (s *ServerState) handlePeerConnect(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	r.Body = http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 2<<20)
	var body struct {
		PeerID string `json:"peer_id"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil || body.PeerID == "" {
		http.Error(w, "peer_id required", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 15*time.Second)
	defer cancel()

	s.Broadcast("connection_request_sent", body.PeerID, fmt.Sprintf("Establishing P2P link with %s...", body.PeerID), nil)

	_, err := s.node.ConnectPeer(ctx, body.PeerID)
	if err != nil {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, map[string]any{"error": err.Error()})
		return
	}

	metrics, _ := s.node.GetPathMetrics(body.PeerID)
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"status":  "connected",
		"peer_id": body.PeerID,
		"metrics": metrics,
	})
}

func (s *ServerState) handlePeerDisconnect(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	r.Body = http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 2<<20)
	var body struct {
		PeerID string `json:"peer_id"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil || body.PeerID == "" {
		http.Error(w, "peer_id required", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	err := s.node.DisconnectPeer(body.PeerID)
	if err != nil {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, map[string]any{"error": err.Error()})
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"status": "disconnected", "peer_id": body.PeerID})
}

func (s *ServerState) handlePeerPing(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	r.Body = http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 2<<20)
	var body struct {
		PeerID string `json:"peer_id"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil || body.PeerID == "" {
		http.Error(w, "peer_id required", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	pingID := uuid.New().String()[:8]
	respCh := make(chan time.Duration, 1)

	s.pingMu.Lock()
	s.pendingPings[pingID] = respCh
	s.pingMu.Unlock()

	defer func() {
		s.pingMu.Lock()
		delete(s.pendingPings, pingID)
		s.pingMu.Unlock()
	}()

	nowNano := fmt.Sprintf("%d", time.Now().UnixNano())
	err := s.node.SendStream(body.PeerID, []byte(fmt.Sprintf("__PING__:%s:%s", nowNano, pingID)))
	if err != nil {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, map[string]any{"error": err.Error()})
		return
	}

	select {
	case rtt := <-respCh:
		rttMs := float64(rtt.Microseconds()) / 1000.0
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
			"status":      "pong_received",
			"peer_id":     body.PeerID,
			"duration_ms": rtt.Milliseconds(),
			"rtt_ms":      rttMs,
		})
	case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
			"status":      "ping_timeout",
			"peer_id":     body.PeerID,
			"duration_ms": 5000,
			"rtt_ms":      5000.0,
		})
	}
}

func (s *ServerState) handlePeerStream(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	r.Body = http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 2<<20)
	var body struct {
		PeerID  string `json:"peer_id"`
		Message string `json:"message"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil || body.PeerID == "" {
		http.Error(w, "peer_id and message required", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	err := s.node.SendStream(body.PeerID, []byte(body.Message))
	if err != nil {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, map[string]any{"error": err.Error()})
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"status": "sent", "peer_id": body.PeerID})
}

	prof, enabled := s.node.GPUProfile()
	wdStat, _ := s.node.GPUWatchdogStatus()
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"enabled":  enabled,
		"profile":  prof,
		"watchdog": wdStat,
	})
}

func (s *ServerState) handleGPUHipify(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	r.Body = http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 2<<20)
	var body struct {
		Source string `json:"source"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil || body.Source == "" {
		http.Error(w, "source code required", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	res := gpu.TranslateCUDAToHIP(body.Source)
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, res)
}

func (s *ServerState) handleGPURun(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	r.Body = http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 2<<20)
	var body struct {
		TaskType   string `json:"task_type"`
		SourceCode string `json:"source_code"`
		Batches    int    `json:"batches"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request body", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	if body.Batches <= 0 {
		body.Batches = 20
	}

	req := gpu.GPUTaskRequest{
		JobID: "gpu-job-" + uuid.New().String()[:8],
		Manifest: gpu.TaskCapsuleManifest{
			Name:         "gui-task",
			TargetTier:   "tier3",
			TaskType:     body.TaskType,
			TotalBatches: body.Batches,
		},
		SourceCode:     body.SourceCode,
		TimeoutSeconds: 60,
	}

	if body.TaskType == "inference" {
		req.InputTensors = map[string][]float32{
			"input": {1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0},
		}
	}

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 60*time.Second)
	defer cancel()

	startGPU := time.Now()
	resp, err := s.node.ExecuteGPUTask(ctx, req)
	durMs := time.Since(startGPU).Milliseconds()

	status := "COMPLETED"
	if err != nil {
		status = "FAILED"
	}
	s.addTask(ClusterTask{
		JobID:       req.JobID,
		ClassAd:     fmt.Sprintf("Simulated ONNX Runner && Task == %q", body.TaskType),
		TargetMatch: fmt.Sprintf("Matched -> %s (DirectML Tier 3)", s.nodeConfig.NodeID),
		StageDAG:    "LOCAL_GPU_SIMULATION",
		Priority:    "P0 CRITICAL",
		Status:      status,
		DurationMs:  durMs,
		Timestamp:   time.Now().Format("15:04:05"),
	})

	if err != nil {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, map[string]any{"error": err.Error(), "resp": resp})
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, resp)
}

func (s *ServerState) isPeerConnected(peerID string) bool {
	for _, p := range s.node.GetConnectedPeers() {
		if p == peerID {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func (s *ServerState) handleCodeRun(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	r.Body = http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 2<<20)
	var body struct {
		PeerID   string `json:"peer_id"`
		Language string `json:"language"`
		Source   string `json:"source"`
		Stdin    string `json:"stdin"`
		Timeout  int    `json:"timeout"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil || body.Source == "" {
		http.Error(w, "language and source required", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	if body.Timeout <= 0 {
		body.Timeout = 10
	}

	req := codeexec.Request{
		JobID:          "code-" + uuid.New().String()[:8],
		Language:       body.Language,
		Source:         body.Source,
		Stdin:          body.Stdin,
		TimeoutSeconds: body.Timeout,
	}

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Duration(body.Timeout+15)*time.Second)
	defer cancel()

	startRun := time.Now()

	// If local node or local worker is selected:
	if body.PeerID == "local" || body.PeerID == s.nodeConfig.NodeID || body.PeerID == "" {
		if !s.node.HasCodeExecutor() {
			s.addTask(ClusterTask{
				JobID:       req.JobID,
				ClassAd:     fmt.Sprintf("SandboxTier == Tier2 && Lang == %q", body.Language),
				TargetMatch: fmt.Sprintf("Matched -> %s (Local)", s.nodeConfig.NodeID),
				StageDAG:    "DAG_STAGE_CONTAINER_EXEC",
				Priority:    "P1 HIGH",
				Status:      "FAILED (NO_DOCKER)",
				DurationMs:  0,
				Timestamp:   time.Now().Format("15:04:05"),
			})
			writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
				"job_id":      req.JobID,
				"language":    body.Language,
				"exit_code":   -1,
				"duration_ms": 0,
				"error":       "Docker is not available or code execution is disabled on this worker. Start Docker Desktop (WSL2 backend) to execute Tier 2 containers locally, or target a connected fleet peer.",
			})
			return
		}

		resp, err := s.node.ExecuteCodeLocal(ctx, req)
		durMs := time.Since(startRun).Milliseconds()
		taskStatus := "COMPLETED"
		if err != nil || resp.ExitCode != 0 {
			taskStatus = "FAILED"
		}
		s.addTask(ClusterTask{
			JobID:       req.JobID,
			ClassAd:     fmt.Sprintf("SandboxTier == Tier2 && Lang == %q", body.Language),
			TargetMatch: fmt.Sprintf("Matched -> %s (Local)", s.nodeConfig.NodeID),
			StageDAG:    "DAG_STAGE_CONTAINER_EXEC",
			Priority:    "P1 HIGH",
			Status:      taskStatus,
			DurationMs:  durMs,
			Timestamp:   time.Now().Format("15:04:05"),
		})

		if err != nil {
			writeJSON(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, map[string]any{"error": err.Error(), "resp": resp})
			return
		}
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, resp)
		return
	}

	// Remote peer execution over WebRTC DataChannel.
	// If peer is in the fleet but not yet connected via WebRTC, auto-connect on-demand.
	if !s.isPeerConnected(body.PeerID) {
		s.Broadcast("P2P_CONNECT", body.PeerID, fmt.Sprintf("Auto-establishing direct WebRTC link with %s via coordinator...", body.PeerID), nil)
		connectCtx, cancelConnect := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 10*time.Second)
		_, err := s.node.ConnectPeer(connectCtx, body.PeerID)
		cancelConnect()
		if err != nil {
			s.addTask(ClusterTask{
				JobID:       req.JobID,
				ClassAd:     fmt.Sprintf("SandboxTier == Tier2 && Lang == %q", body.Language),
				TargetMatch: fmt.Sprintf("Matched -> %s", body.PeerID),
				StageDAG:    "DAG_STAGE_CONTAINER_EXEC",
				Priority:    "P1 HIGH",
				Status:      "FAILED (P2P_CONNECT)",
				DurationMs:  time.Since(startRun).Milliseconds(),
				Timestamp:   time.Now().Format("15:04:05"),
			})
			writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
				"job_id":      req.JobID,
				"language":    body.Language,
				"exit_code":   -1,
				"duration_ms": 0,
				"error":       fmt.Sprintf("Failed to auto-connect P2P WebRTC link with %s: %v", body.PeerID, err),
			})
			return
		}
		s.Broadcast("P2P_CONNECTED", body.PeerID, fmt.Sprintf("Direct WebRTC link active with %s. Dispatching task...", body.PeerID), nil)
	}

	resp, err := s.node.ExecuteRemoteCode(ctx, body.PeerID, req)
	durMs := time.Since(startRun).Milliseconds()
	taskStatus := "COMPLETED"
	if err != nil || resp.ExitCode != 0 {
		taskStatus = "FAILED"
	}
	s.addTask(ClusterTask{
		JobID:       req.JobID,
		ClassAd:     fmt.Sprintf("SandboxTier == Tier2 && Lang == %q", body.Language),
		TargetMatch: fmt.Sprintf("Matched -> %s", body.PeerID),
		StageDAG:    "DAG_STAGE_CONTAINER_EXEC",
		Priority:    "P1 HIGH",
		Status:      taskStatus,
		DurationMs:  durMs,
		Timestamp:   time.Now().Format("15:04:05"),
	})

	if err != nil {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, map[string]any{"error": err.Error(), "resp": resp})
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, resp)
}

func (s *ServerState) handleShellExec(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	r.Body = http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 2<<20)
	var body struct {
		PeerID  string `json:"peer_id"`
		Command string `json:"command"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil || body.Command == "" {
		http.Error(w, "command required", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 45*time.Second)
	defer cancel()

	if body.PeerID == "all" {
		res := s.node.ExecuteRemoteCommandAll(ctx, remoteshell.ShellRequest{
			Command:   body.Command,
			ShellType: remoteshell.ShellAuto,
		})
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"results": res})
		return
	}

	s.mu.RLock()
	enabled := s.nodeConfig.EnableRemoteShell
	nodeID := s.nodeConfig.NodeID
	s.mu.RUnlock()

	if body.PeerID == "local" || body.PeerID == nodeID || body.PeerID == "" {
		if !enabled {
			writeJSON(w, http.StatusForbidden, map[string]any{"error": "local/remote shell execution is disabled (start with -enable-remote-shell to opt in)"})
			return
		}
		executor := remoteshell.NewSystemExecutor()
		res := executor.Execute(ctx, remoteshell.ShellRequest{
			Command:   body.Command,
			ShellType: remoteshell.ShellAuto,
		})
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, res)
		return
	}

	// If remote peer is not yet connected via WebRTC, auto-connect on-demand.
	if !s.isPeerConnected(body.PeerID) {
		s.Broadcast("P2P_CONNECT", body.PeerID, fmt.Sprintf("Auto-establishing direct WebRTC link with %s for shell command...", body.PeerID), nil)
		connectCtx, cancelConnect := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 10*time.Second)
		_, err := s.node.ConnectPeer(connectCtx, body.PeerID)
		cancelConnect()
		if err != nil {
			writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, remoteshell.ShellResponse{
				ExitCode: -1,
				Error:    fmt.Sprintf("Failed to auto-connect P2P WebRTC link with %s: %v", body.PeerID, err),
			})
			return
		}
		s.Broadcast("P2P_CONNECTED", body.PeerID, fmt.Sprintf("Direct WebRTC link active with %s. Executing shell...", body.PeerID), nil)
	}

	res, err := s.node.ExecuteRemoteCommand(ctx, body.PeerID, remoteshell.ShellRequest{
		Command:   body.Command,
		ShellType: remoteshell.ShellAuto,
	})
	if err != nil {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, map[string]any{"error": err.Error(), "res": res})
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, res)
}

func (s *ServerState) handleStorageBlobs(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	blobs, err := s.node.ListBlobs()
	if err != nil {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, map[string]any{"error": err.Error()})
		return
	}
	type enrichedBlob struct {
		ID        string    `json:"id"`
		Size      int64     `json:"size"`
		SizeBytes int64     `json:"size_bytes"`
		ModTime   time.Time `json:"mod_time"`
		CreatedAt time.Time `json:"created_at"`
	}
	enriched := make([]enrichedBlob, 0, len(blobs))
	for _, b := range blobs {
		enriched = append(enriched, enrichedBlob{
			ID:        b.ID,
			Size:      b.Size,
			SizeBytes: b.Size,
			ModTime:   b.ModTime,
			CreatedAt: b.ModTime,
		})
	}
	usage := s.node.StorageUsage()
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"blobs": enriched, "usage": usage})
}

func (s *ServerState) handleStorageGet(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	blobID := r.URL.Query().Get("id")
	if blobID == "" {
		http.Error(w, "blob id required", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	reader, err := s.node.GetBlob(blobID)
	if err != nil {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusNotFound, map[string]any{"error": err.Error()})
		return
	}
	defer reader.Close()

	// Read up to 512 KiB for viewer preview
	buf := make([]byte, 512*1024)
	n, _ := io.ReadFull(reader, buf)
	content := string(buf[:n])

	verified, verifyErr := s.node.VerifyBlob(blobID)
	isValid := verified && verifyErr == nil

	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"blob_id":    blobID,
		"content":    content,
		"size":       n,
		"size_bytes": n,
		"verified":   isValid,
		"valid":      isValid,
	})
}

func (s *ServerState) handleStoragePut(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	r.Body = http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 10<<20)
	var body struct {
		Content string `json:"content"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil || body.Content == "" {
		http.Error(w, "content required", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	// Compute real SHA-256 hash as blobID (64 hex characters)
	h := sha256.Sum256([]byte(body.Content))
	blobID := hex.EncodeToString(h[:])
	size, err := s.node.PutBlob(blobID, strings.NewReader(body.Content))
	if err != nil {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, map[string]any{"error": err.Error()})
		return
	}

	s.Broadcast("storage_put", "", fmt.Sprintf("Stored blob %s (%d bytes)", blobID, size), map[string]any{
		"blob_id":    blobID,
		"size":       size,
		"size_bytes": size,
	})
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"blob_id":    blobID,
		"size":       size,
		"size_bytes": size,
	})
}

func (s *ServerState) handleStorageDel(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	r.Body = http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 2<<20)
	var body struct {
		BlobID string `json:"blob_id"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil || body.BlobID == "" {
		http.Error(w, "blob_id required", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	err := s.node.DeleteBlob(body.BlobID)
	if err != nil {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, map[string]any{"error": err.Error()})
		return
	}
	s.Broadcast("storage_del", "", fmt.Sprintf("Deleted blob %s", body.BlobID), body.BlobID)
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"status": "deleted", "blob_id": body.BlobID})
}

func (s *ServerState) handleStorageScrub(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	corrupted, err := s.node.Scrub()
	if err != nil {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, map[string]any{"error": err.Error()})
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"status": "complete", "corrupted": corrupted})
}

func (s *ServerState) handleSamples(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	type SampleItem struct {
		Name     string `json:"name"`
		Category string `json:"category"`
		Language string `json:"language"`
		Content  string `json:"content"`
	}

	samples := []SampleItem{}

	// Dynamically scan samples/ directory recursively
	_ = filepath.Walk("samples", func(path string, info os.FileInfo, err error) error {
		if err != nil || info.IsDir() {
			return nil
		}

		ext := strings.ToLower(filepath.Ext(path))
		var lang, cat string

		switch ext {
		case ".py":
			lang = "python"
			if strings.Contains(path, "security") {
				cat = "Security (O2)"
			} else {
				cat = "Python Container (O2)"
			}
		case ".c":
			lang = "c"
			cat = "C Container (O2)"
		case ".cpp", ".cc":
			lang = "cpp"
			cat = "C++ Container (O2)"
		case ".cu":
			lang = "cuda"
			cat = "GPU Kernel (O3)"
		default:
			return nil
		}

		data, readErr := os.ReadFile(path)
		if readErr == nil {
			samples = append(samples, SampleItem{
				Name:     filepath.Base(path),
				Category: cat,
				Language: lang,
				Content:  string(data),
			})
		}
		return nil
	})

	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"samples": samples})
}

func (s *ServerState) handleEventsWS(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	conn, err := s.upgrader.Upgrade(w, r, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	client := &wsClient{conn: conn}

	s.wsMu.Lock()
	s.wsClients[client] = true
	backlog := make([]EventMessage, len(s.eventLog))
	copy(backlog, s.eventLog)
	s.wsMu.Unlock()

	// Send recent backlog without holding wsMu
	for _, evt := range backlog {
		client.writeMu.Lock()
		_ = client.conn.SetWriteDeadline(time.Now().Add(2 * time.Second))
		err := client.conn.WriteJSON(evt)
		client.writeMu.Unlock()
		if err != nil {
			s.wsMu.Lock()
			delete(s.wsClients, client)
			s.wsMu.Unlock()
			_ = conn.Close()
			return
		}
	}

	defer func() {
		s.wsMu.Lock()
		delete(s.wsClients, client)
		s.wsMu.Unlock()
		_ = conn.Close()
	}()

	// Read pump to detect close
	for {
		_, _, err := conn.ReadMessage()
		if err != nil {
			break
		}
	}
}

func setupTestServer(t *testing.T, coordinatorURL string) (*ServerState, *http.ServeMux, func()) {
	t.Helper()
	tempDir, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "gui-api-test-*")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("failed to create temp dir: %v", err)
	}

	storageDir := filepath.Join(tempDir, "storage")
	_ = os.MkdirAll(storageDir, 0755)

	nCfg := node.NodeConfig{
		NodeID:          "test-gui-node",
		PoolID:          "test-pool",
		StorageDir:      storageDir,
		StorageQuota:    10 * 1024 * 1024,
		SignalingURL:    coordinatorURL,
		FallbackTimeout: 2 * time.Second,
	}

	n, err := node.NewNode(nCfg)
	if err != nil {
		os.RemoveAll(tempDir)
		t.Fatalf("failed to create test node: %v", err)
	}

	s := NewServerState(n, nCfg, false, gpu.ManagerConfig{})
	s.SetActivePort(8080)
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	s.SetupRoutes(mux)

	cleanup := func() {
		_ = n.Close()
		_ = os.RemoveAll(tempDir)
	}

	return s, mux, cleanup
}

		t.Errorf("expected storage_bytes field in response")
	}

		t.Errorf("expected avg_rtt_ms field in response")
	}

	if data["fleet_count"] != float64(0) {
		t.Errorf("expected fleet_count 0, got %v", data["fleet_count"])

	if data["direct_peers_count"] != float64(0) {

func TestCoordinatorSettings_ValidationAndRotation(t *testing.T) {
	s, mux, cleanup := setupTestServer(t, "ws://127.0.0.1:8080/ws")
	defer cleanup()

	token := s.SessionToken()

	// 1. GET default settings
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/api/coordinator/settings", nil)
	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	if rec.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("GET /api/coordinator/settings expected 200, got %d", rec.Code)
	}

	var getRes map[string]any
	_ = json.Unmarshal(rec.Body.Bytes(), &getRes)
	if getRes["relay_threshold"] != 2.0 {
		t.Errorf("expected default relay_threshold 2.0, got %v", getRes["relay_threshold"])
	}

	// 2. POST valid relay_threshold update
	postBody := `{"relay_threshold": 3.5}`
	req = httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/api/coordinator/settings", bytes.NewBufferString(postBody))
	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	rec = httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	if rec.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("POST valid threshold expected 200, got %d: %s", rec.Code, rec.Body.String())
	}

	var postRes map[string]any
	_ = json.Unmarshal(rec.Body.Bytes(), &postRes)
	if postRes["relay_threshold"] != 3.5 {
		t.Errorf("expected updated relay_threshold 3.5, got %v", postRes["relay_threshold"])
	}
	if s.node.FallbackTimeout() != 3500*time.Millisecond {
		t.Errorf("expected node FallbackTimeout to be 3.5s, got %v", s.node.FallbackTimeout())
	}

	// 3. POST threshold below bounds (< 0.5s) -> 400 Bad Request
	req = httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/api/coordinator/settings", bytes.NewBufferString(`{"relay_threshold": 0.2}`))
	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	rec = httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	if rec.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {
		t.Errorf("expected 400 Bad Request for threshold < 0.5, got %d", rec.Code)
	}

	// 4. POST threshold above bounds (> 5.0s) -> 400 Bad Request
	req = httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/api/coordinator/settings", bytes.NewBufferString(`{"relay_threshold": 5.5}`))
	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	rec = httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	if rec.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {
		t.Errorf("expected 400 Bad Request for threshold > 5.0, got %d", rec.Code)
	}

	// 5. POST malformed JSON -> 400 Bad Request
	req = httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/api/coordinator/settings", bytes.NewBufferString(`{invalid json`))
	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	rec = httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	if rec.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {
		t.Errorf("expected 400 Bad Request for malformed JSON, got %d", rec.Code)
	}

	// 6. POST rotate token
	req = httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/api/coordinator/settings", bytes.NewBufferString(`{"rotate_token": true}`))
	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	rec = httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	if rec.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected 200 OK on rotate_token, got %d", rec.Code)
	}
	var rotateRes map[string]any
	_ = json.Unmarshal(rec.Body.Bytes(), &rotateRes)
	newToken, ok := rotateRes["join_token"].(string)
	if !ok || !strings.HasPrefix(newToken, "UC-") || len(newToken) < 11 {
		t.Errorf("expected rotated token with UC- prefix and 11+ chars, got %v", newToken)
	}
}

func TestTasks_Endpoint(t *testing.T) {
	s, mux, cleanup := setupTestServer(t, "ws://127.0.0.1:8080/ws")
	defer cleanup()

	token := s.SessionToken()

	// 1. GET initial tasks: count must be 0 (no fake seed tasks)
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/api/tasks", nil)
	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	if rec.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("GET /api/tasks expected 200, got %d", rec.Code)
	}

	var res struct {
		Tasks []ClusterTask `json:"tasks"`
		Count int           `json:"count"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(rec.Body.Bytes(), &res); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("failed to unmarshal tasks: %v", err)
	}
	if res.Count != 0 {
		t.Errorf("expected initial task count 0, got %d", res.Count)
	}
	if len(res.Tasks) != 0 {
		t.Errorf("expected empty tasks slice, got %d tasks", len(res.Tasks))
	}

	// 2. POST a new task
	newTask := `{"class_ad": "Tier == 2", "target_match": "PC-Node-09", "stage_dag": "DAG_STAGE_TEST", "priority": "P1 HIGH", "status": "QUEUED"}`
	req = httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/api/tasks", bytes.NewBufferString(newTask))
	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	rec = httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	if rec.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("POST /api/tasks expected 200, got %d: %s", rec.Code, rec.Body.String())
	}

	var created ClusterTask
	_ = json.Unmarshal(rec.Body.Bytes(), &created)
	if !strings.HasPrefix(created.JobID, "#JOB-") {
		t.Errorf("expected auto-generated #JOB- prefix, got %v", created.JobID)
	}
	if created.ClassAd != "Tier == 2" {
		t.Errorf("expected ClassAd 'Tier == 2', got %v", created.ClassAd)
	}

	// 3. GET tasks again, count must now be 1
	req = httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/api/tasks", nil)
	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
	rec = httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	if rec.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("GET /api/tasks expected 200, got %d", rec.Code)
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(rec.Body.Bytes(), &res); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("failed to unmarshal tasks: %v", err)
	}
	if res.Count != 1 {
		t.Errorf("expected task count 1 after creation, got %d", res.Count)
	}

	// 4. POST invalid JSON
	req = httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/api/tasks", bytes.NewBufferString(`{invalid json`))
	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	rec = httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	if rec.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {
		t.Errorf("expected 400 Bad Request on invalid task JSON, got %d", rec.Code)
	}
}

func TestAPI_SecurityAuthAndOrigin(t *testing.T) {
	s, mux, cleanup := setupTestServer(t, "ws://127.0.0.1:8080/ws")
	defer cleanup()

	token := s.SessionToken()

	// 1. Missing Authorization header returns 401 Unauthorized
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/api/tasks", nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	if rec.Code != http.StatusUnauthorized {
		t.Errorf("expected 401 Unauthorized for missing token, got %d", rec.Code)
	}

	// 2. Invalid Bearer token returns 401 Unauthorized
	req = httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/api/tasks", nil)
	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer wrong-token")
	rec = httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	if rec.Code != http.StatusUnauthorized {
		t.Errorf("expected 401 Unauthorized for invalid token, got %d", rec.Code)
	}

	// 3. POST with Content-Type: text/plain returns 415 Unsupported Media Type
	req = httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/api/coordinator/settings", bytes.NewBufferString(`{"relay_threshold": 3.0}`))
	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "text/plain")
	rec = httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	if rec.Code != http.StatusUnsupportedMediaType {
		t.Errorf("expected 415 Unsupported Media Type for text/plain, got %d", rec.Code)
	}

	// 4. Request with forbidden external Origin returns 403 Forbidden
	req = httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/api/tasks", nil)
	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
	req.Header.Set("Origin", "http://evil.com")
	rec = httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	if rec.Code != http.StatusForbidden {
		t.Errorf("expected 403 Forbidden for external origin, got %d", rec.Code)
	}

	// 5. Request with matching loopback Origin succeeds
	req = httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/api/tasks", nil)
	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
	req.Header.Set("Origin", "http://127.0.0.1:8080")
	rec = httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	if rec.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Errorf("expected 200 OK for valid origin, got %d", rec.Code)
	}

	// 6. Unauthenticated POST to /api/shell/exec returns 401 Unauthorized (GUI RCE blocked)
	req = httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/api/shell/exec", bytes.NewBufferString(`{"command":"whoami"}`))
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	rec = httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	if rec.Code != http.StatusUnauthorized {
		t.Errorf("expected 401 Unauthorized on unauthenticated /api/shell/exec, got %d", rec.Code)
	}

	// 7. Mutating POST to /api/shell/exec with Content-Type: text/plain returns 415 Unsupported Media Type
	req = httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/api/shell/exec", bytes.NewBufferString(`{"command":"whoami"}`))
	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "text/plain")
	rec = httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	if rec.Code != http.StatusUnsupportedMediaType {
		t.Errorf("expected 415 Unsupported Media Type on /api/shell/exec with text/plain, got %d", rec.Code)
	}
}

func TestStorageCAS_PutAndGet(t *testing.T) {
	s, mux, cleanup := setupTestServer(t, "ws://127.0.0.1:8080/ws")
	defer cleanup()

	token := s.SessionToken()
	testPayload := "hello unicompute storage verification cas content"

	// 1. POST /api/storage/put
	putBody, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]string{"content": testPayload})
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/api/storage/put", bytes.NewReader(putBody))
	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

	if rec.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("POST /api/storage/put expected 200, got %d: %s", rec.Code, rec.Body.String())
	}

	var putRes map[string]any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(rec.Body.Bytes(), &putRes); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("failed to decode put response: %v", err)
	}

	blobID, ok := putRes["blob_id"].(string)
	if !ok || len(blobID) != 64 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 64-char hex SHA-256 blob_id, got %v", putRes["blob_id"])
	}

	// 2. GET /api/storage/get?id=<blobID>
	req = httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/api/storage/get?id="+blobID, nil)
	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
	rec = httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

	if rec.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("GET /api/storage/get expected 200, got %d: %s", rec.Code, rec.Body.String())
	}

	var getRes map[string]any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(rec.Body.Bytes(), &getRes); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("failed to decode get response: %v", err)
	}

	if getRes["blob_id"] != blobID {
		t.Errorf("expected blob_id %s, got %v", blobID, getRes["blob_id"])
	}
	if getRes["content"] != testPayload {
		t.Errorf("expected content %q, got %q", testPayload, getRes["content"])
	}
	if getRes["verified"] != true {
		t.Errorf("expected verified == true, got %v", getRes["verified"])
	}
	if getRes["valid"] != true {
		t.Errorf("expected valid == true, got %v", getRes["valid"])
	}
}

func TestAPI_LocalShellBlockedByDefault(t *testing.T) {
	s, mux, cleanup := setupTestServer(t, "ws://127.0.0.1:8080/ws")
	defer cleanup()

	token := s.SessionToken()
	reqBody := `{"peer_id":"local","command":"echo hi"}`

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/api/shell/exec", bytes.NewBufferString(reqBody))
	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

	if rec.Code != http.StatusForbidden {
		t.Fatalf("expected 403 Forbidden when EnableRemoteShell is false, got %d: %s", rec.Code, rec.Body.String())
	}

	var res map[string]any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(rec.Body.Bytes(), &res); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("failed to parse response JSON: %v", err)
	}

	expectedErr := "local/remote shell execution is disabled (start with -enable-remote-shell to opt in)"
	if res["error"] != expectedErr {
		t.Errorf("expected error %q, got %v", expectedErr, res["error"])
	}
}

func TestAPI_OriginAllowRemoteGUI(t *testing.T) {
	s, mux, cleanup := setupTestServer(t, "ws://127.0.0.1:8080/ws")
	defer cleanup()

	token := s.SessionToken()

	// 1. allowRemoteGUI == false: non-loopback Origin matching r.Host is rejected with 403 Forbidden
	s.SetAllowRemoteGUI(false)

	req1 := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/api/status", nil)
	req1.Host = "192.168.1.50:23080"
	req1.Header.Set("Origin", "http://192.168.1.50:23080")
	req1.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
	rec1 := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec1, req1)

	if rec1.Code != http.StatusForbidden {
		t.Fatalf("expected 403 Forbidden when allowRemoteGUI == false for non-loopback Origin, got %d: %s", rec1.Code, rec1.Body.String())
	}

	// 2. allowRemoteGUI == true: non-loopback Origin matching r.Host is accepted (200 OK)
	s.SetAllowRemoteGUI(true)

	req2 := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/api/status", nil)
	req2.Host = "192.168.1.50:23080"
	req2.Header.Set("Origin", "http://192.168.1.50:23080")
	req2.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
	rec2 := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec2, req2)

	if rec2.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected 200 OK when allowRemoteGUI == true for same-origin non-loopback Origin, got %d: %s", rec2.Code, rec2.Body.String())
	}
}

//go:build linux

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
)

// launchDesktopWindow opens a dedicated native desktop window on Linux (Ubuntu 18.04, 20.04, 24.04).
func launchDesktopWindow(url string) (*exec.Cmd, error) {
	// If running headless or without X11/Wayland display server, return nil
	if os.Getenv("DISPLAY") == "" && os.Getenv("WAYLAND_DISPLAY") == "" {
		return nil, nil
	}

	userDataDir := filepath.Join(os.TempDir(), "unicompute_gui_profile")

	browsers := []string{
		"google-chrome",
		"google-chrome-stable",
		"chromium-browser",
		"chromium",
		"microsoft-edge",
		"microsoft-edge-stable",
		"brave-browser",
	}

	for _, b := range browsers {
		if path, err := exec.LookPath(b); err == nil {
			args := []string{
				fmt.Sprintf("--app=%s", url),
				"--window-size=1440,900",
				"--class=UniCompute",
				"--disable-features=TranslateUI",
				fmt.Sprintf("--user-data-dir=%s", userDataDir),
			}
			cmd := exec.Command(path, args...)
			if err := cmd.Start(); err == nil {
				return cmd, nil
			}
		}
	}

	// Fallback to xdg-open on standard desktop environments
	if path, err := exec.LookPath("xdg-open"); err == nil {
		cmd := exec.Command(path, url)
		if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return nil, nil
	}

	return nil, nil
}

//go:build windows

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
)

// launchDesktopWindow opens a dedicated, borderless native desktop window on Windows.
func launchDesktopWindow(url string) (*exec.Cmd, error) {
	var candidates []string

	if pf := os.Getenv("ProgramFiles"); pf != "" {
		candidates = append(candidates,
			filepath.Join(pf, `Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe`),
			filepath.Join(pf, `Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe`),
			filepath.Join(pf, `BraveSoftware\Brave-Browser\Application\brave.exe`),
		)
	}
	if pf86 := os.Getenv("ProgramFiles(x86)"); pf86 != "" {
		candidates = append(candidates,
			filepath.Join(pf86, `Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe`),
			filepath.Join(pf86, `Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe`),
		)
	}
	if la := os.Getenv("LocalAppData"); la != "" {
		candidates = append(candidates,
			filepath.Join(la, `Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe`),
			filepath.Join(la, `Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe`),
		)
	}

	candidates = append(candidates,
		`C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe`,
		`C:\Program Files\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe`,
		`C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe`,
		`C:\Program Files (x86)\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe`,
		`C:\Program Files\BraveSoftware\Brave-Browser\Application\brave.exe`,
	)

	userDataDir := filepath.Join(os.TempDir(), "unicompute_gui_profile")

	for _, exe := range candidates {
		if _, err := os.Stat(exe); err == nil {
			args := []string{
				fmt.Sprintf("--app=%s", url),
				"--window-size=1440,900",
				"--disable-features=TranslateUI",
				"--disable-extensions",
				fmt.Sprintf("--user-data-dir=%s", userDataDir),
			}
			cmd := exec.Command(exe, args...)
			if err := cmd.Start(); err == nil {
				return cmd, nil
			}
		}
	}

	// Fallback to default shell handler if no Chromium browser path matched
	cmd := exec.Command("powershell", "-NoProfile", "-Command", fmt.Sprintf("Start-Process '%s'", url))
	if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return nil, nil
}

FILE: cmd/unicompute-gui/main.go

package main

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"log"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"syscall"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/unicompute/obj1/pkg/codeexec"
	"github.com/unicompute/obj1/pkg/gpu"
	"github.com/unicompute/obj1/pkg/node"
)

//go:embed web/*
var embeddedWebFS embed.FS

func main() {
	nodeID := flag.String("id", "", "Unique node identifier (default: generated UUID)")
	poolID := flag.String("pool", "default-pool", "Storage pool identifier")
	storageDir := flag.String("storage", "", "Storage directory for chunk blobs")
	quotaGB := flag.Int64("quota-gb", 10, "Contributed storage quota in GiB")
	signalingURL := flag.String("signaling", "wss://unicompute-coordinator.onrender.com/ws", "Coordinator signaling WebSocket URL")
	authToken := flag.String("auth-token", os.Getenv("UNICOMPUTE_AUTH_TOKEN"), "Coordinator signaling authentication token")
	stunServer := flag.String("stun", "stun.l.google.com:19302", "STUN server address")
	stunServer6 := flag.String("stun6", "", "IPv6 STUN server address")
	enableGPU := flag.Bool("enable-gpu", true, "Enable Objective 3 GPU acceleration and resource governance")
	enableCode := flag.Bool("enable-code-execution", true, "Enable Docker sandbox code execution if available")
	codeAllowlist := flag.String("code-allowlist", "", "Comma-separated peer IDs allowed to submit code jobs (* for any)")
	enableRemoteShell := flag.Bool("enable-remote-shell", false, "Enable remote shell execution on this node (requires allowlist)")
	shellAllowlist := flag.String("shell-allowlist", "", "Comma-separated peer IDs allowed to execute remote shell commands")
	headless := flag.Bool("headless", false, "Run in headless server mode without launching desktop window")
	port := flag.Int("port", 23080, "Port for GUI web server")
	listenHost := flag.String("listen", "127.0.0.1", "Host interface to bind the GUI server to (use 0.0.0.0 for LAN)")
	allowRemoteGUI := flag.Bool("allow-remote-gui", false, "Allow binding GUI server to non-loopback interfaces")

	flag.Parse()

	if *enableRemoteShell && strings.TrimSpace(*shellAllowlist) == "" {
		log.Fatalf("[FATAL] -enable-remote-shell is true but -shell-allowlist is empty; remote shell startup refused for security")
	}

	if *listenHost != "127.0.0.1" && *listenHost != "localhost" && *listenHost != "::1" && !*allowRemoteGUI {
		log.Fatalf("[FATAL] Refusing to bind GUI server to non-loopback interface '%s' without -allow-remote-gui flag\n", *listenHost)
	}

	if *nodeID == "" {
		*nodeID = "node-" + uuid.New().String()[:8]
	}

	if *storageDir == "" {
		home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
		if err != nil {
			home = "."
		}
		*storageDir = filepath.Join(home, ".unicompute", "storage", *nodeID)
	}

	var stunListV4 []string
	if *stunServer != "" {
		for _, s := range strings.Split(*stunServer, ",") {
			if s = strings.TrimSpace(s); s != "" {
				stunListV4 = append(stunListV4, s)
			}
		}
	}

	var stunListV6 []string
	if *stunServer6 != "" {
		for _, s := range strings.Split(*stunServer6, ",") {
			if s = strings.TrimSpace(s); s != "" {
				stunListV6 = append(stunListV6, s)
			}
		}
	}

	var shellList []string
	if *shellAllowlist != "" {
		for _, s := range strings.Split(*shellAllowlist, ",") {
			if s = strings.TrimSpace(s); s != "" {
				shellList = append(shellList, s)
			}
		}
	}

	quotaBytes := *quotaGB * 1024 * 1024 * 1024
	nodeCfg := node.NodeConfig{
		NodeID:            *nodeID,
		PoolID:            *poolID,
		StorageDir:        *storageDir,
		StorageQuota:      quotaBytes,
		SignalingURL:      *signalingURL,
		AuthToken:         *authToken,
		STUNServersV4:     stunListV4,
		STUNServersV6:     stunListV6,
		FallbackTimeout:   2000 * time.Millisecond,
		EnableRemoteShell: *enableRemoteShell,
		ShellAllowlist:    shellList,
	}

	n, err := node.NewNode(nodeCfg)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("[FATAL] Failed to initialize UniCompute node: %v\n", err)
	}
	defer n.Close()

	// Initialize GPU Subsystem (Objective 3)
	gpuCfg := gpu.ManagerConfig{
		StorageDir:          filepath.Join(*storageDir, "gpu"),
		MaxMemoryBytes:      2048 * 1024 * 1024,
		PreferredBackend:    gpu.BackendDirectML,
		WatchdogInterval:    50 * time.Millisecond,
		UserActiveThreshold: 1000 * time.Millisecond,
		ResumeGracePeriod:   30 * time.Second,
	}

	if *enableGPU {
		if err := n.EnableGPU(gpuCfg); err != nil {
			log.Printf("[WARN] Failed to enable GPU subsystem: %v\n", err)
		} else {
			prof, _ := n.GPUProfile()
			log.Printf("[GPU] Objective 3 enabled: %s (%s, %d MB VRAM, DirectML=%v, CUDA=%v)",
				prof.DeviceName, prof.Vendor, prof.TotalVRAMBytes/(1024*1024), prof.DirectMLSupported, prof.CUDASupported)
		}
	}

	// Initialize Docker Sandbox (Objective 2) if Docker is present
	if *enableCode {
		dockerCtx, cancelDocker := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 3*time.Second)
		if err := codeexec.CheckDocker(dockerCtx); err == nil {
			var allowedPeers []string
			if *codeAllowlist != "" {
				for _, p := range strings.Split(*codeAllowlist, ",") {
					if p = strings.TrimSpace(p); p != "" {
						allowedPeers = append(allowedPeers, p)
					}
				}
			}
			n.SetCodeExecutor(codeexec.NewDockerExecutor(codeexec.Config{
				DefaultTimeout: 10 * time.Second,
				MaxTimeout:     30 * time.Second,
				MaxConcurrent:  2,
			}), allowedPeers...)
			log.Println("[CODEEXEC] Tier 2 Docker sandbox active on worker")
		} else {
			log.Printf("[CODEEXEC] Docker not available (%v); container jobs will be forwarded to peers\n", err)
		}
		cancelDocker()
	}

	ctx, cancelNode := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer cancelNode()

	log.Printf("[INFO] Starting UniCompute node '%s' on %s...\n", *nodeID, *signalingURL)
	if err := n.Start(ctx); err != nil {
		log.Printf("[WARN] Node startup note: %v (operating in local/direct mode)\n", err)
	}

	// Initialize GUI Server State & API Mux
	state := NewServerState(n, nodeCfg, *enableGPU, gpuCfg)
	state.SetAllowRemoteGUI(*allowRemoteGUI)
	sessionToken := state.SessionToken()
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	state.SetupRoutes(mux)

	// Serve web frontend assets: prefer live disk directory if present, fallback to embedded assets
	var fileHandler http.Handler
	candidates := []string{
		"cmd/unicompute-gui/web",
		"web",
		filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(os.Args[0]), "web"),
		filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(os.Args[0]), "cmd", "unicompute-gui", "web"),
	}
	var diskDir string
	for _, c := range candidates {
		if info, err := os.Stat(c); err == nil && info.IsDir() {
			if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(c, "index.html")); err == nil {
				diskDir = c
				break
			}
		}
	}
	if diskDir != "" {
		log.Printf("[GUI] Serving live web frontend assets from disk: %s\n", diskDir)
		fileHandler = http.FileServer(http.Dir(diskDir))
	} else {
		subFS, err := fs.Sub(embeddedWebFS, "web")
		if err != nil {
			log.Fatalf("[FATAL] Failed to access embedded web files: %v\n", err)
		}
		fileHandler = http.FileServer(http.FS(subFS))
	}
	mux.Handle("/", fileHandler)

	// Find free port if default is occupied
	listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", *listenHost, *port))
	if err != nil {
		// Fallback to random free port
		listener, err = net.Listen("tcp", fmt.Sprintf("%s:0", *listenHost))
		if err != nil {
			log.Fatalf("[FATAL] Failed to bind local GUI server: %v\n", err)
		}
	}
	actualPort := listener.Addr().(*net.TCPAddr).Port
	state.SetActivePort(actualPort)
	guiURL := fmt.Sprintf("http://127.0.0.1:%d", actualPort)
	desktopURL := fmt.Sprintf("%s/#token=%s", guiURL, sessionToken)

	srv := &http.Server{Handler: mux}
	go func() {
		if err := srv.Serve(listener); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
			log.Printf("[ERROR] GUI server error: %v\n", err)
		}
	}()

	fmt.Println("=========================================================================")
	fmt.Println(" UniCompute Native Desktop Application Active")
	fmt.Printf(" Node ID:        %s\n", *nodeID)
	fmt.Printf(" Coordinator:    %s\n", *signalingURL)
	fmt.Printf(" Local GUI URL:  %s\n", desktopURL)
	fmt.Println("=========================================================================")

	shutdownCh := make(chan struct{})

	// Launch dedicated native desktop app window unless headless
	if !*headless {
		go func() {
			time.Sleep(300 * time.Millisecond)
			log.Printf("[GUI] Launching native desktop window for %s...\n", desktopURL)
			cmd, err := launchDesktopWindow(desktopURL)
			if err != nil {
				log.Printf("[WARN] Could not spawn desktop window (%v). Access GUI via: %s\n", err, desktopURL)
			} else if cmd != nil {
				_ = cmd.Wait() // When user closes desktop window, trigger graceful exit
				log.Println("[GUI] Desktop window closed by user. Exiting daemon...")
				close(shutdownCh)
			}
		}()
	} else {
		log.Printf("[HEADLESS] Running in headless mode. Open %s in your browser.\n", desktopURL)
	}

	sigCh := make(chan os.Signal, 1)
	signal.Notify(sigCh, os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
	select {
	case <-sigCh:
	case <-shutdownCh:
	}

	log.Println("[INFO] Shutting down UniCompute GUI gracefully...")
	shutdownCtx, shutdownCancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 3*time.Second)
	defer shutdownCancel()
	_ = srv.Shutdown(shutdownCtx)
}
