package relay

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/rand"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/hex"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net"
	"sync"
	"time"
)

// Magic bytes identifying the UniCompute Contributor Relay protocol (Syncthing relay-v1 inspired)
const (
	RelayMagic   uint32 = 0x554E4952 // 'UNIR'
	RelayVersion byte   = 0x01

	MsgTypeCreateSession byte = 0x01
	MsgTypeJoinSession   byte = 0x02
	MsgTypeSessionReady  byte = 0x03
	MsgTypeError         byte = 0x04
	MsgTypePing          byte = 0x05
	MsgTypePong          byte = 0x06
)

var (
	ErrSessionNotFound   = errors.New("relay session not found")
	ErrSessionExpired    = errors.New("relay session expired")
	ErrSessionOccupied   = errors.New("relay session already occupied")
	ErrInvalidMagic      = errors.New("invalid relay magic")
	ErrRateLimitExceeded = errors.New("relay rate limit exceeded")
)

// GenerateSessionToken creates a secure random session token for relay coordination.
func GenerateSessionToken() string {
	b := make([]byte, 16)
	_, _ = rand.Read(b)
	return hex.EncodeToString(b)
}

// ServerConfig configures the Contributor Relay Server.
type ServerConfig struct {
	ListenAddr     string
	RateLimitBytes int64         // Maximum bytes/sec per connection (0 for unlimited)
	SessionTimeout time.Duration // Time to wait for peer to join before expiring
	MaxSessions    int
}

// ContributorRelay implements a peer-elected, high-performance opaque forwarding relay.
// The relay forwards encrypted bytes without inspection (blind relaying), matching pairs
// via cryptographic session tokens.
type ContributorRelay struct {
	mu           sync.Mutex
	cfg          ServerConfig
	listener     net.Listener
	sessions     map[string]*relaySession
	running      bool
	closeCh      chan struct{}
	totalRelayed int64
}

type relaySession struct {
	token     string
	creatorID string
	creator   net.Conn
	created   time.Time
	readyCh   chan net.Conn
}

// NewContributorRelay starts a contributor relay server.
func NewContributorRelay(cfg ServerConfig) (*ContributorRelay, error) {
	if cfg.ListenAddr == "" {
		cfg.ListenAddr = "127.0.0.1:0"
	}
	if cfg.SessionTimeout == 0 {
		cfg.SessionTimeout = 30 * time.Second
	}
	if cfg.MaxSessions == 0 {
		cfg.MaxSessions = 1000
	}

	ln, err := net.Listen("tcp", cfg.ListenAddr)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to listen on %s: %w", cfg.ListenAddr, err)
	}

	r := &ContributorRelay{
		cfg:      cfg,
		listener: ln,
		sessions: make(map[string]*relaySession),
		closeCh:  make(chan struct{}),
		running:  true,
	}

	go r.acceptLoop()
	go r.cleanupLoop()

	return r, nil
}

// Addr returns the listener's network address.
func (r *ContributorRelay) Addr() net.Addr {
	return r.listener.Addr()
}

func (r *ContributorRelay) acceptLoop() {
	for {
		conn, err := r.listener.Accept()
		if err != nil {
			select {
			case <-r.closeCh:
				return
			default:
				time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond)
				continue
			}
		}

		go r.handleConn(conn)
	}
}

func (r *ContributorRelay) handleConn(conn net.Conn) {
	// Read handshake header:
	// [0..3]: Magic (0x554E4952)
	// [4]: Version (0x01)
	// [5]: MsgType (CreateSession = 0x01, JoinSession = 0x02)
	// [6..7]: TokenLength (uint16)
	// [8..8+len]: Token string
	header := make([]byte, 8)
	_ = conn.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(10 * time.Second))
	if _, err := io.ReadFull(conn, header); err != nil {
		_ = conn.Close()
		return
	}

	magic := binary.BigEndian.Uint32(header[0:4])
	if magic != RelayMagic {
		_ = conn.Close()
		return
	}

	version := header[4]
	if version != RelayVersion {
		_ = conn.Close()
		return
	}

	msgType := header[5]
	tokenLen := binary.BigEndian.Uint16(header[6:8])
	if tokenLen == 0 || tokenLen > 256 {
		_ = conn.Close()
		return
	}

	tokenBuf := make([]byte, tokenLen)
	if _, err := io.ReadFull(conn, tokenBuf); err != nil {
		_ = conn.Close()
		return
	}
	token := string(tokenBuf)

	_ = conn.SetDeadline(time.Time{}) // Clear deadline

	r.mu.Lock()
	switch msgType {
	case MsgTypeCreateSession:
		if len(r.sessions) >= r.cfg.MaxSessions {
			r.mu.Unlock()
			_ = conn.Close()
			return
		}

		session := &relaySession{
			token:   token,
			creator: conn,
			created: time.Now(),
			readyCh: make(chan net.Conn, 1),
		}
		r.sessions[token] = session
		r.mu.Unlock()

		// Wait for joiner or timeout
		select {
		case joiner, ok := <-session.readyCh:
			if !ok || joiner == nil {
				return
			}
			// Both peers connected! Notify creator
			_ = sendControlMsg(conn, MsgTypeSessionReady)
			r.bridgeConns(conn, joiner)
		case <-time.After(r.cfg.SessionTimeout):
			r.mu.Lock()
			delete(r.sessions, token)
			r.mu.Unlock()
			_ = sendControlMsg(conn, MsgTypeError)
			_ = conn.Close()
		case <-r.closeCh:
			_ = conn.Close()
		}

	case MsgTypeJoinSession:
		session, ok := r.sessions[token]
		if !ok {
			r.mu.Unlock()
			_ = sendControlMsg(conn, MsgTypeError)
			_ = conn.Close()
			return
		}
		delete(r.sessions, token)
		r.mu.Unlock()

		// Send ready to joiner
		_ = sendControlMsg(conn, MsgTypeSessionReady)
		session.readyCh <- conn

	default:
		r.mu.Unlock()
		_ = conn.Close()
	}
}

func sendControlMsg(conn net.Conn, msgType byte) error {
	buf := make([]byte, 6)
	binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(buf[0:4], RelayMagic)
	buf[4] = RelayVersion
	buf[5] = msgType
	_, err := conn.Write(buf)
	return err
}

func (r *ContributorRelay) bridgeConns(c1, c2 net.Conn) {
	defer c1.Close()
	defer c2.Close()

	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	wg.Add(2)

	pipe := func(dst, src net.Conn) {
		defer wg.Done()
		buf := make([]byte, 64*1024)
		for {
			nr, err := src.Read(buf)
			if nr > 0 {
				r.mu.Lock()
				r.totalRelayed += int64(nr)
				rateLimit := r.cfg.RateLimitBytes
				r.mu.Unlock()

				if rateLimit > 0 {
					delay := time.Duration(float64(nr) / float64(rateLimit) * float64(time.Second))
					if delay > 0 {
						time.Sleep(delay)
					}
				}

				nw, ew := dst.Write(buf[0:nr])
				if ew != nil || nw != nr {
					break
				}
			}
			if err != nil {
				break
			}
		}
		// Send half-close if supported
		if tc, ok := dst.(*net.TCPConn); ok {
			_ = tc.CloseWrite()
		}
	}

	go pipe(c1, c2)
	go pipe(c2, c1)

	wg.Wait()
}

func (r *ContributorRelay) cleanupLoop() {
	ticker := time.NewTicker(10 * time.Second)
	defer ticker.Stop()

	for {
		select {
		case <-ticker.C:
			r.mu.Lock()
			now := time.Now()
			for token, session := range r.sessions {
				if now.Sub(session.created) > r.cfg.SessionTimeout {
					_ = session.creator.Close()
					delete(r.sessions, token)
				}
			}
			r.mu.Unlock()
		case <-r.closeCh:
			return
		}
	}
}

// TotalRelayedBytes returns the cumulative number of bytes relayed through this node.
func (r *ContributorRelay) TotalRelayedBytes() int64 {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	return r.totalRelayed
}

// Close stops the contributor relay server.
func (r *ContributorRelay) Close() error {
	r.mu.Lock()
	if !r.running {
		r.mu.Unlock()
		return nil
	}
	r.running = false
	close(r.closeCh)
	err := r.listener.Close()

	for _, session := range r.sessions {
		_ = session.creator.Close()
	}
	r.sessions = make(map[string]*relaySession)
	r.mu.Unlock()
	return err
}

// RelayClient provides client-side functionality to establish connections via a Contributor Relay.
type RelayClient struct{}

// CreateRelayedSession registers a session on the relay and waits for the peer to join.
func (c *RelayClient) CreateRelayedSession(ctx context.Context, relayAddr string, token string) (net.Conn, error) {
	conn, err := net.Dial("tcp", relayAddr)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to dial relay %s: %w", relayAddr, err)
	}

	// Send CreateSession header
	header := make([]byte, 8+len(token))
	binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(header[0:4], RelayMagic)
	header[4] = RelayVersion
	header[5] = MsgTypeCreateSession
	binary.BigEndian.PutUint16(header[6:8], uint16(len(token)))
	copy(header[8:], []byte(token))

	if _, err := conn.Write(header); err != nil {
		_ = conn.Close()
		return nil, err
	}

	// Read session ready response
	resp := make([]byte, 6)
	_ = conn.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(30 * time.Second))
	if _, err := io.ReadFull(conn, resp); err != nil {
		_ = conn.Close()
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("waiting for peer failed: %w", err)
	}
	_ = conn.SetDeadline(time.Time{})

	if binary.BigEndian.Uint32(resp[0:4]) != RelayMagic || resp[5] != MsgTypeSessionReady {
		_ = conn.Close()
		return nil, errors.New("relay session rejected or failed")
	}

	return conn, nil
}

// JoinRelayedSession connects to the relay and joins an existing session initiated by a peer.
func (c *RelayClient) JoinRelayedSession(ctx context.Context, relayAddr string, token string) (net.Conn, error) {
	conn, err := net.Dial("tcp", relayAddr)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to dial relay %s: %w", relayAddr, err)
	}

	// Send JoinSession header
	header := make([]byte, 8+len(token))
	binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(header[0:4], RelayMagic)
	header[4] = RelayVersion
	header[5] = MsgTypeJoinSession
	binary.BigEndian.PutUint16(header[6:8], uint16(len(token)))
	copy(header[8:], []byte(token))

	if _, err := conn.Write(header); err != nil {
		_ = conn.Close()
		return nil, err
	}

	// Read session ready response
	resp := make([]byte, 6)
	_ = conn.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(10 * time.Second))
	if _, err := io.ReadFull(conn, resp); err != nil {
		_ = conn.Close()
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("joining relay session failed: %w", err)
	}
	_ = conn.SetDeadline(time.Time{})

	if binary.BigEndian.Uint32(resp[0:4]) != RelayMagic || resp[5] != MsgTypeSessionReady {
		_ = conn.Close()
		return nil, errors.New("relay session join rejected")
	}

	return conn, nil
}

package relay

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"io"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestContributorRelay_EndToEnd(t *testing.T) {
	relay, err := NewContributorRelay(ServerConfig{
		ListenAddr:     "127.0.0.1:0",
		SessionTimeout: 5 * time.Second,
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("failed to start contributor relay: %v", err)
	}
	defer relay.Close()

	relayAddr := relay.Addr().String()
	token := GenerateSessionToken()

	client := &RelayClient{}

	var conn1, conn2 io.ReadWriteCloser
	var err1, err2 error
	var wg sync.WaitGroup

	wg.Add(2)

	// Peer 1 creates session
	go func() {
		defer wg.Done()
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 3*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		conn1, err1 = client.CreateRelayedSession(ctx, relayAddr, token)
	}()

	// Slight delay before Peer 2 joins
	time.Sleep(50 * time.Millisecond)

	// Peer 2 joins session
	go func() {
		defer wg.Done()
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 3*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		conn2, err2 = client.JoinRelayedSession(ctx, relayAddr, token)
	}()

	wg.Wait()

	if err1 != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Peer 1 CreateRelayedSession failed: %v", err1)
	}
	defer conn1.Close()

	if err2 != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Peer 2 JoinRelayedSession failed: %v", err2)
	}
	defer conn2.Close()

	// Exchange data bidirectionally
	msg1 := []byte("hello from peer 1 across blind relay")
	msg2 := []byte("hello back from peer 2 across blind relay")

	_, err = conn1.Write(msg1)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("conn1 write failed: %v", err)
	}

	buf2 := make([]byte, len(msg1))
	_, err = io.ReadFull(conn2, buf2)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("conn2 read failed: %v", err)
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(buf2, msg1) {
		t.Fatalf("conn2 received %q, want %q", string(buf2), string(msg1))
	}

	_, err = conn2.Write(msg2)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("conn2 write failed: %v", err)
	}

	buf1 := make([]byte, len(msg2))
	_, err = io.ReadFull(conn1, buf1)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("conn1 read failed: %v", err)
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(buf1, msg2) {
		t.Fatalf("conn1 received %q, want %q", string(buf1), string(msg2))
	}

	time.Sleep(50 * time.Millisecond)
	total := relay.TotalRelayedBytes()
	expectedTotal := int64(len(msg1) + len(msg2))
	if total < expectedTotal {
		t.Errorf("expected at least %d relayed bytes, got %d", expectedTotal, total)
	}
}

func TestContributorRelay_NotFoundOrTimeout(t *testing.T) {
	relay, err := NewContributorRelay(ServerConfig{

		SessionTimeout: 500 * time.Millisecond,

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 1*time.Second)

	_, err = client.JoinRelayedSession(ctx, relayAddr, "nonexistent-token")
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected error joining nonexistent session, got nil")
	}

	ctx2, cancel2 := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 2*time.Second)
	defer cancel2()
	_, err = client.CreateRelayedSession(ctx2, relayAddr, "timeout-token")
	if err == nil {

	}
}

	username := "volunteer-node-42"

	}

	if turnSrv.Addr() == "" {
		t.Fatalf("expected active turn address")
	}
	_ = user
}

package relay

import (
	"crypto/hmac"
	"crypto/sha1"
	"encoding/base64"
	"fmt"
	"net"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/pion/turn/v2"
)

// TURNConfig holds settings for an embedded TURN server.
type TURNConfig struct {
	PublicIP string
	Port     int
	Realm    string
	Secret   string            // Shared secret for coturn-compatible REST API credentials
	Users    map[string]string // Static username -> password
	MinPort  uint16
	MaxPort  uint16
}

// EmbeddedTURN wraps pion/turn/v2 for local and coordinator-embedded relay capabilities.
type EmbeddedTURN struct {
	mu     sync.Mutex
	server *turn.Server
	cfg    TURNConfig
	addr   string
}

// NewEmbeddedTURN spins up a local or public embedded TURN server.
func NewEmbeddedTURN(cfg TURNConfig) (*EmbeddedTURN, error) {
	if cfg.Port == 0 {
		cfg.Port = 3478
	}
	if cfg.Realm == "" {
		cfg.Realm = "unicompute.local"
	}
	if cfg.PublicIP == "" {
		cfg.PublicIP = "127.0.0.1"
	}

	udpListener, err := net.ListenPacket("udp4", "0.0.0.0:"+strconv.Itoa(cfg.Port))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create TURN UDP listener on port %d: %w", cfg.Port, err)
	}

	turnServer, err := turn.NewServer(turn.ServerConfig{
		Realm: cfg.Realm,
		AuthHandler: func(username string, realm string, srcAddr net.Addr) ([]byte, bool) {
			// Check static configured users first
			if pw, ok := cfg.Users[username]; ok {
				return turn.GenerateAuthKey(username, realm, pw), true
			}

			// Support standard coturn-compatible REST credentials if secret is configured
			if cfg.Secret != "" {
				parts := strings.SplitN(username, ":", 2)
				if len(parts) == 2 {
					expiry, err := strconv.ParseInt(parts[0], 10, 64)
					if err == nil && expiry >= time.Now().Unix() {
						mac := hmac.New(sha1.New, []byte(cfg.Secret))
						mac.Write([]byte(username))
						pw := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
						return turn.GenerateAuthKey(username, realm, pw), true
					}
				}
			}

			return nil, false
		},
		PacketConnConfigs: []turn.PacketConnConfig{
			{
				PacketConn: udpListener,
				RelayAddressGenerator: &turn.RelayAddressGeneratorStatic{
					RelayAddress: net.ParseIP(cfg.PublicIP),
					Address:      "0.0.0.0",
				},
			},
		},
	})
	if err != nil {
		_ = udpListener.Close()
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to initialize pion/turn server: %w", err)
	}

	return &EmbeddedTURN{
		server: turnServer,
		cfg:    cfg,
		addr:   udpListener.LocalAddr().String(),
	}, nil
}

// Addr returns the TURN listening address.
func (t *EmbeddedTURN) Addr() string {
	return t.addr
}

// Close terminates the TURN server.
func (t *EmbeddedTURN) Close() error {
	t.mu.Lock()
	defer t.mu.Unlock()
	if t.server != nil {
		return t.server.Close()
	}
	return nil
}

// GenerateRESTCredentials generates coturn-compatible time-limited HMAC-SHA1 credentials
// for WebRTC ICE TURN configuration (draft-uberti-behave-turn-rest).
func GenerateRESTCredentials(username, secret string, ttlSeconds int64) (string, string) {
	expiry := time.Now().Unix() + ttlSeconds
	user := fmt.Sprintf("%d:%s", expiry, username)
	mac := hmac.New(sha1.New, []byte(secret))
	mac.Write([]byte(user))
	password := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
	return user, password
}

// language: Go, file: pkg/remoteshell/executor.go, runtime: Go 1.22+, target: Windows/Linux/macOS
package remoteshell

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"runtime"
	"sync"
	"time"
)

const MaxShellOutputBytes = 256 * 1024 // 256 KiB cap per stream

type cappedBuffer struct {
	mu        sync.Mutex
	buf       bytes.Buffer
	limit     int
	truncated bool
}

func newCappedBuffer(limit int) *cappedBuffer {
	return &cappedBuffer{limit: limit}
}

func (b *cappedBuffer) Write(p []byte) (int, error) {
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	remaining := b.limit - b.buf.Len()
	if remaining > 0 {
		if remaining > len(p) {
			remaining = len(p)
		}
		_, _ = b.buf.Write(p[:remaining])
	}
	if len(p) > remaining {
		b.truncated = true
	}
	return len(p), nil
}

func (b *cappedBuffer) String() string {
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	str := b.buf.String()
	if b.truncated {
		str += "\n[output truncated]"
	}
	return str
}

// Executor defines interface for executing shell commands locally.
type Executor interface {
	Execute(ctx context.Context, req ShellRequest) ShellResponse
}

// SystemExecutor executes commands on the underlying operating system.
type SystemExecutor struct{}

// NewSystemExecutor instantiates a cross-platform system shell executor.
func NewSystemExecutor() *SystemExecutor {
	return &SystemExecutor{}
}

// Execute runs the requested command in a subshell, capturing stdout, stderr, exit code, and runtime.
func (e *SystemExecutor) Execute(ctx context.Context, req ShellRequest) ShellResponse {
	start := time.Now()

	timeoutMs := req.TimeoutMs
	if timeoutMs <= 0 {
		timeoutMs = 30000 // default 30-second timeout
	}

	execCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, time.Duration(timeoutMs)*time.Millisecond)
	defer cancel()

	cmd := buildCommand(execCtx, req.Command, req.ShellType)

	if req.WorkDir != "" {
		cmd.Dir = req.WorkDir
	}

	if len(req.Env) > 0 {
		cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(), req.Env...)
	}

	stdoutBuf := newCappedBuffer(MaxShellOutputBytes)
	stderrBuf := newCappedBuffer(MaxShellOutputBytes)
	cmd.Stdout = stdoutBuf
	cmd.Stderr = stderrBuf

	runErr := cmd.Run()
	elapsed := time.Since(start).Milliseconds()

	resp := ShellResponse{
		ExecID:     req.ExecID,
		Stdout:     stdoutBuf.String(),
		Stderr:     stderrBuf.String(),
		DurationMs: elapsed,
	}

	if runErr != nil {
		var exitErr *exec.ExitError
		if errors.As(runErr, &exitErr) {
			resp.ExitCode = exitErr.ExitCode()
		} else {
			resp.ExitCode = -1
		}

		if errors.Is(execCtx.Err(), context.DeadlineExceeded) {
			resp.Error = "command execution timed out"
		} else {
			resp.Error = runErr.Error()
		}
	} else {
		resp.ExitCode = 0
	}

	return resp
}

// buildCommand selects the appropriate interpreter based on OS and requested shell type.
func buildCommand(ctx context.Context, command string, requestedShell ShellType) *exec.Cmd {
	if runtime.GOOS == "windows" {
		switch requestedShell {
		case ShellCmd:
			return exec.CommandContext(ctx, "cmd.exe", "/c", command)
		case ShellPowerShell, ShellAuto, "":
			return exec.CommandContext(ctx, "powershell.exe", "-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-Command", command)
		default:
			// Fallback to powershell on Windows
			return exec.CommandContext(ctx, "powershell.exe", "-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-Command", command)
		}
	}

	// Linux, macOS, Unix
	switch requestedShell {
	case ShellSh:
		return exec.CommandContext(ctx, "/bin/sh", "-c", command)
	case ShellBash, ShellAuto, "":
		if bashPath, err := exec.LookPath("bash"); err == nil {
			return exec.CommandContext(ctx, bashPath, "-c", command)
		}
		return exec.CommandContext(ctx, "/bin/sh", "-c", command)
	default:
		return exec.CommandContext(ctx, "/bin/sh", "-c", command)
	}
}

// language: Go, file: pkg/remoteshell/executor_test.go, runtime: Go 1.22+, target: Windows/Linux/macOS
package remoteshell

import (
	"context"
	"runtime"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestEncodeDecodeRequest(t *testing.T) {
	orig := ShellRequest{
		ExecID:    "exec-test-123",
		Command:   "whoami",
		ShellType: ShellPowerShell,
		TimeoutMs: 5000,
		WorkDir:   "C:\\Temp",
		Env:       []string{"FOO=BAR"},
	}

	encoded, err := EncodeRequest(orig)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("EncodeRequest failed: %v", err)
	}

	decoded, err := DecodeRequest(encoded)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("DecodeRequest failed: %v", err)
	}

	if decoded.ExecID != orig.ExecID || decoded.Command != orig.Command || decoded.ShellType != orig.ShellType {
		t.Fatalf("mismatch in decoded request: %+v vs %+v", decoded, orig)
	}
}

func TestEncodeDecodeResponse(t *testing.T) {
	orig := ShellResponse{
		ExecID:     "exec-test-123",
		ExitCode:   0,
		Stdout:     "output line 1\noutput line 2",
		Stderr:     "",
		DurationMs: 42,
		Error:      "",
	}

	encoded, err := EncodeResponse(orig)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("EncodeResponse failed: %v", err)
	}

	decoded, err := DecodeResponse(encoded)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("DecodeResponse failed: %v", err)
	}

	if decoded.ExecID != orig.ExecID || decoded.Stdout != orig.Stdout || decoded.ExitCode != orig.ExitCode {
		t.Fatalf("mismatch in decoded response: %+v vs %+v", decoded, orig)
	}
}

func TestSystemExecutor_Timeout(t *testing.T) {
	exec := NewSystemExecutor()
	ctx := context.Background()

	var cmdStr string
	if runtime.GOOS == "windows" {
		cmdStr = "Start-Sleep -Seconds 5"
	} else {
		cmdStr = "sleep 5"
	}

	req := ShellRequest{
		ExecID:    "test-timeout",
		Command:   cmdStr,
		ShellType: ShellAuto,
		TimeoutMs: 500, // 500ms timeout vs 5s sleep
	}

	start := time.Now()
	resp := exec.Execute(ctx, req)
	elapsed := time.Since(start)

	if resp.ExitCode == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("expected non-zero exit code on timeout")
	}
	if !strings.Contains(resp.Error, "timed out") {
		t.Fatalf("expected timeout error, got: %s", resp.Error)
	}
	if elapsed > 3*time.Second {
		t.Fatalf("execution took too long to timeout: %v", elapsed)
	}
}

func TestSystemExecutor_OutputCapped(t *testing.T) {
	buf := newCappedBuffer(1024)
	largeData := make([]byte, 5000)
	for i := range largeData {
		largeData[i] = 'A'
	}
	n, err := buf.Write(largeData)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected write error: %v", err)
	}
	if n != len(largeData) {
		t.Errorf("expected %d bytes reported written, got %d", len(largeData), n)
	}
	str := buf.String()
	if !strings.HasSuffix(str, "\n[output truncated]") {
		t.Errorf("expected string to end with truncation notice")
	}
	if buf.buf.Len() > 1024 {
		t.Errorf("expected buffer len <= 1024, got %d", buf.buf.Len())
	}

	executor := NewSystemExecutor()
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()

	var cmdStr string
	if runtime.GOOS == "windows" {
		cmdStr = "powershell -Command \"Write-Output ('X' * 300000)\""
	} else {
		cmdStr = "python3 -c \"print('X' * 300000)\" || printf '%*s' 300000 ''"
	}

	req := ShellRequest{
		ExecID:    "test-cap",
		Command:   cmdStr,
		ShellType: ShellAuto,
		TimeoutMs: 5000,
	}

	resp := executor.Execute(ctx, req)
	if len(resp.Stdout) > MaxShellOutputBytes+100 {
		t.Errorf("expected stdout to be capped at ~%d bytes, got %d", MaxShellOutputBytes, len(resp.Stdout))
	}
	if !strings.Contains(resp.Stdout, "[output truncated]") {
		t.Errorf("expected stdout to contain truncation notice")
	}
}

// language: Go, file: pkg/remoteshell/types.go, runtime: Go 1.22+, target: Windows/Linux/macOS
package remoteshell

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
)

const (
	// Wire protocol prefixes for DataChannel stream multiplexing
	PrefixShellReq  = "__SHELL_REQ__:"
	PrefixShellResp = "__SHELL_RESP__:"
)

// ShellType specifies which interpreter to invoke.
type ShellType string

const (
	ShellAuto       ShellType = "auto"
	ShellPowerShell ShellType = "powershell"
	ShellCmd        ShellType = "cmd"
	ShellBash       ShellType = "bash"
	ShellSh         ShellType = "sh"
)

// ShellRequest represents a remote command execution request.
type ShellRequest struct {
	ExecID    string    `json:"exec_id"`
	Command   string    `json:"command"`
	ShellType ShellType `json:"shell_type,omitempty"`
	TimeoutMs int64     `json:"timeout_ms,omitempty"`
	WorkDir   string    `json:"work_dir,omitempty"`
	Env       []string  `json:"env,omitempty"`
}

// ShellResponse represents the result of a command execution returned by a remote peer.
type ShellResponse struct {
	ExecID     string `json:"exec_id"`
	ExitCode   int    `json:"exit_code"`
	Stdout     string `json:"stdout"`
	Stderr     string `json:"stderr"`
	DurationMs int64  `json:"duration_ms"`
	Error      string `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

// EncodeRequest serializes a ShellRequest into wire format.
func EncodeRequest(req ShellRequest) ([]byte, error) {
	data, err := json.Marshal(req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal shell request: %w", err)
	}
	return []byte(PrefixShellReq + string(data)), nil
}

// DecodeRequest deserializes a ShellRequest from wire format.
func DecodeRequest(data []byte) (ShellRequest, error) {
	str := string(data)
	if !strings.HasPrefix(str, PrefixShellReq) {
		return ShellRequest{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid shell request prefix")
	}
	payload := strings.TrimPrefix(str, PrefixShellReq)
	var req ShellRequest
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(payload), &req); err != nil {
		return ShellRequest{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to unmarshal shell request: %w", err)
	}
	return req, nil
}

// EncodeResponse serializes a ShellResponse into wire format.
func EncodeResponse(resp ShellResponse) ([]byte, error) {
	data, err := json.Marshal(resp)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal shell response: %w", err)
	}
	return []byte(PrefixShellResp + string(data)), nil
}

// DecodeResponse deserializes a ShellResponse from wire format.
func DecodeResponse(data []byte) (ShellResponse, error) {
	str := string(data)
	if !strings.HasPrefix(str, PrefixShellResp) {
		return ShellResponse{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid shell response prefix")
	}
	payload := strings.TrimPrefix(str, PrefixShellResp)
	var resp ShellResponse
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(payload), &resp); err != nil {
		return ShellResponse{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to unmarshal shell response: %w", err)
	}
	return resp, nil
}

package signaling

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/subtle"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"math/rand"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/gorilla/websocket"
	"github.com/unicompute/obj1/pkg/protocol"
)

var upgrader = websocket.Upgrader{
	ReadBufferSize:  64 * 1024,
	WriteBufferSize: 64 * 1024,
	CheckOrigin: func(r *http.Request) bool {
		return true // Allow all origins for local & peer testing
	},
}

// Hub manages WebSocket signaling connections and routes messages between peers.
type Hub struct {
	mu         sync.RWMutex
	clients    map[string]*clientConn
	httpServer *http.Server
	listener   net.Listener
	addr       string
	authToken  string
	closed     bool
}

type clientConn struct {
	nodeID   string
	conn     *websocket.Conn
	sendChan chan []byte
	writeMu  sync.Mutex
	hub      *Hub
	done     chan struct{}
	doneOnce sync.Once
}

// NewHub starts a signaling hub HTTP server on the given address, optionally requiring an auth token.
func NewHub(listenAddr string, authTokens ...string) (*Hub, error) {
	if listenAddr == "" {
		listenAddr = "127.0.0.1:0"
	}

	ln, err := net.Listen("tcp", listenAddr)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to listen on %s: %w", listenAddr, err)
	}

	h := &Hub{
		clients:  make(map[string]*clientConn),
		listener: ln,
		addr:     ln.Addr().String(),
	}
	if len(authTokens) > 0 {
		h.authToken = authTokens[0]
	}

	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	mux.HandleFunc("/ws", h.handleWebSocket)
	mux.HandleFunc("/health", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"status":"healthy","service":"unicompute-coordinator"}`))
	})
	mux.HandleFunc("/api/nodes", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		h.mu.RLock()
		token := h.authToken
		h.mu.RUnlock()

		if token != "" {
			reqToken := ""
			authHeader := r.Header.Get("Authorization")
			if strings.HasPrefix(authHeader, "Bearer ") {
				reqToken = strings.TrimPrefix(authHeader, "Bearer ")
			} else if qToken := r.URL.Query().Get("token"); qToken != "" {
				reqToken = qToken
			}
			if subtle.ConstantTimeCompare([]byte(reqToken), []byte(token)) != 1 {
				http.Error(w, "Unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
				return
			}
		}

		h.mu.RLock()
		nodes := make([]string, 0, len(h.clients))
		for id := range h.clients {
			nodes = append(nodes, id)
		}
		h.mu.RUnlock()
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]interface{}{
			"count": len(nodes),
			"nodes": nodes,
		})
	})

	h.httpServer = &http.Server{
		Handler: mux,
	}

	go func() {
		_ = h.httpServer.Serve(ln)
	}()

	return h, nil
}

// Addr returns the signaling hub's network address.
func (h *Hub) Addr() string {
	return h.addr
}

// URL returns the WebSocket URL to connect to.
func (h *Hub) URL() string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("ws://%s/ws", h.addr)
}

// Close shuts down the signaling hub.
func (h *Hub) Close() error {
	h.mu.Lock()
	if h.closed {
		h.mu.Unlock()
		return nil
	}
	h.closed = true
	for _, c := range h.clients {
		_ = c.conn.Close()
	}
	h.clients = make(map[string]*clientConn)
	h.mu.Unlock()

	return h.httpServer.Close()
}

// SetAuthToken configures or updates the cluster auth token for the hub.
func (h *Hub) SetAuthToken(token string) {
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	h.authToken = token
}

func (h *Hub) handleWebSocket(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	h.mu.RLock()
	token := h.authToken
	h.mu.RUnlock()

	if token != "" {
		reqToken := ""
		authHeader := r.Header.Get("Authorization")
		if strings.HasPrefix(authHeader, "Bearer ") {
			reqToken = strings.TrimPrefix(authHeader, "Bearer ")
		} else if qToken := r.URL.Query().Get("token"); qToken != "" {
			reqToken = qToken
		}
		if subtle.ConstantTimeCompare([]byte(reqToken), []byte(token)) != 1 {
			http.Error(w, "Unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
			return
		}
	}

	conn, err := upgrader.Upgrade(w, r, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}

	c := &clientConn{
		conn:     conn,
		sendChan: make(chan []byte, 100),
		hub:      h,
		done:     make(chan struct{}),
	}

	go c.writePump()
	c.readPump()
}

func (c *clientConn) readPump() {
	defer func() {
		c.doneOnce.Do(func() {
			close(c.done)
		})
		if c.nodeID != "" {
			c.hub.mu.Lock()
			delete(c.hub.clients, c.nodeID)
			// Broadcast peer left notification to all remaining nodes
			leftPayload, _ := json.Marshal(protocol.PeerEventPayload{NodeID: c.nodeID})
			leftEnv, _ := json.Marshal(protocol.Envelope{
				Type:     protocol.MsgPeerLeft,
				SenderID: "coordinator",
				Payload:  leftPayload,
			})
			for _, other := range c.hub.clients {
				select {
				case other.sendChan <- leftEnv:
				default:
				}
			}
			c.hub.mu.Unlock()
		}
		_ = c.conn.Close()
	}()

	// Section 6.3: "Fix: pong handler, read deadline, 20 s ping ticker"
	_ = c.conn.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(60 * time.Second))
	c.conn.SetPongHandler(func(string) error {
		_ = c.conn.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(60 * time.Second))
		return nil
	})

	for {
		_, msg, err := c.conn.ReadMessage()
		if err != nil {
			break
		}

		var env protocol.Envelope
		if err := json.Unmarshal(msg, &env); err != nil {
			continue
		}

		if env.Type == protocol.MsgRegister {
			var reg protocol.RegisterPayload
			_ = json.Unmarshal(env.Payload, &reg)
			targetNodeID := reg.NodeID
			if targetNodeID == "" {
				targetNodeID = env.SenderID
			}

			c.hub.mu.Lock()
			if existing, exists := c.hub.clients[targetNodeID]; exists && existing != c {
				c.hub.mu.Unlock()
				// Reject duplicate registration to prevent silent session hijacking
				errMsg, _ := json.Marshal(protocol.Envelope{
					Type:     protocol.MsgRegisterAck,
					SenderID: "coordinator",
					TargetID: targetNodeID,
					Payload:  []byte(`{"error":"duplicate nodeID registration rejected"}`),
				})
				select {
				case c.sendChan <- errMsg:
				default:
				}
				time.Sleep(50 * time.Millisecond)
				c.writeMu.Lock()
				_ = c.conn.WriteMessage(websocket.CloseMessage,
					websocket.FormatCloseMessage(websocket.ClosePolicyViolation, "duplicate nodeID registration rejected"))
				c.writeMu.Unlock()
				return
			}
			c.nodeID = targetNodeID
			c.hub.clients[c.nodeID] = c

			// Broadcast peer joined notification to all OTHER nodes
			joinPayload, _ := json.Marshal(protocol.PeerEventPayload{NodeID: c.nodeID})
			joinEnv, _ := json.Marshal(protocol.Envelope{
				Type:     protocol.MsgPeerJoined,
				SenderID: "coordinator",
				Payload:  joinPayload,
			})
			for id, other := range c.hub.clients {
				if id != c.nodeID {
					select {
					case other.sendChan <- joinEnv:
					default:
					}
				}
			}
			c.hub.mu.Unlock()

			ackEnv := protocol.Envelope{
				Type:     protocol.MsgRegisterAck,
				SenderID: "coordinator",
				TargetID: c.nodeID,
			}
			data, _ := json.Marshal(ackEnv)
			select {
			case c.sendChan <- data:
			default:
			}
			continue
		}

		if env.Type == protocol.MsgPeerListRequest {
			c.hub.mu.RLock()
			nodes := make([]string, 0, len(c.hub.clients))
			for id := range c.hub.clients {
				nodes = append(nodes, id)
			}
			c.hub.mu.RUnlock()

			respPayload, _ := json.Marshal(protocol.PeerListPayload{Nodes: nodes})
			respEnv := protocol.Envelope{
				Type:     protocol.MsgPeerListResponse,
				SenderID: "coordinator",
				TargetID: c.nodeID,
				Payload:  respPayload,
			}
			data, _ := json.Marshal(respEnv)
			select {
			case c.sendChan <- data:
			default:
			}
			continue
		}

		// Route message to target peer
		if env.TargetID != "" {
			if c.nodeID == "" {
				continue
			}
			if env.SenderID != "" && env.SenderID != c.nodeID {
				continue
			}
			env.SenderID = c.nodeID
			routedPayload, err := json.Marshal(env)
			if err != nil {
				continue
			}

			c.hub.mu.RLock()
			target, ok := c.hub.clients[env.TargetID]
			c.hub.mu.RUnlock()
			if ok {
				select {
				case target.sendChan <- routedPayload:
				default:
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

func (c *clientConn) writePump() {
	ticker := time.NewTicker(20 * time.Second) // 20s ping ticker as specified in Section 6.3
	defer func() {
		ticker.Stop()
		c.writeMu.Lock()
		_ = c.conn.Close()
		c.writeMu.Unlock()
	}()

	for {
		select {
		case <-c.done:
			return
		case msg, ok := <-c.sendChan:
			c.writeMu.Lock()
			if !ok {
				_ = c.conn.WriteMessage(websocket.CloseMessage, []byte{})
				c.writeMu.Unlock()
				return
			}
			_ = c.conn.SetWriteDeadline(time.Now().Add(10 * time.Second))
			err := c.conn.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, msg)
			c.writeMu.Unlock()
			if err != nil {
				return
			}
		case <-ticker.C:
			c.writeMu.Lock()
			_ = c.conn.SetWriteDeadline(time.Now().Add(10 * time.Second))
			err := c.conn.WriteMessage(websocket.PingMessage, nil)
			c.writeMu.Unlock()
			if err != nil {
				return
			}
		}
	}
}

// Client connects to the signaling hub and handles peer negotiation.
type Client struct {
	mu           sync.Mutex
	writeMu      sync.Mutex // Serializes all writes to WebSocket connection
	url          string
	nodeID       string
	authToken    string
	conn         *websocket.Conn
	handler      func(protocol.Envelope)
	reconnectCtx context.Context
	cancel       context.CancelFunc
	sendQueue    chan []byte
	closed       bool
}

// NewClient initializes a signaling client with auto-reconnection and keepalive.
func NewClient(wsURL string, nodeID string, handler func(protocol.Envelope), authTokens ...string) (*Client, error) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	c := &Client{
		url:          wsURL,
		nodeID:       nodeID,
		handler:      handler,
		reconnectCtx: ctx,
		cancel:       cancel,
		sendQueue:    make(chan []byte, 100),
	}
	if len(authTokens) > 0 {
		c.authToken = authTokens[0]
	}

	if err := c.connect(); err != nil {
		cancel()
		return nil, err
	}

	go c.readLoop()
	go c.writeLoop()
	return c, nil
}

func (c *Client) connect() error {
	dialer := websocket.Dialer{
		HandshakeTimeout: 5 * time.Second,
	}

	header := make(http.Header)
	if c.authToken != "" {
		header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+c.authToken)
	}

	conn, _, err := dialer.DialContext(c.reconnectCtx, c.url, header)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	c.mu.Lock()
	c.conn = conn
	c.mu.Unlock()

	// Register immediately under write lock
	regPayload, _ := json.Marshal(protocol.RegisterPayload{
		NodeID: c.nodeID,
	})
	regEnv := protocol.Envelope{
		Type:     protocol.MsgRegister,
		SenderID: c.nodeID,
		Payload:  regPayload,
	}
	data, _ := json.Marshal(regEnv)

	c.writeMu.Lock()
	defer c.writeMu.Unlock()
	_ = conn.SetWriteDeadline(time.Now().Add(5 * time.Second))
	return conn.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, data)
}

func (c *Client) readLoop() {
	for {
		c.mu.Lock()
		conn := c.conn
		closed := c.closed
		c.mu.Unlock()

		if closed {
			return
		}

		if conn == nil {
			c.reconnect()
			continue
		}

		// Keepalive: read deadline and pong handler
		_ = conn.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(60 * time.Second))
		conn.SetPongHandler(func(string) error {
			_ = conn.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(60 * time.Second))
			return nil
		})

		_, msg, err := conn.ReadMessage()
		if err != nil {
			c.mu.Lock()
			if !c.closed {
				_ = c.conn.Close()
				c.conn = nil
			}
			c.mu.Unlock()
			c.reconnect()
			continue
		}

		var env protocol.Envelope
		if err := json.Unmarshal(msg, &env); err == nil && c.handler != nil {
			c.handler(env)
		}
	}
}

func (c *Client) reconnect() {
	// Section 10: "agents retry with jittered backoff capped at 8 s"
	backoff := 500 * time.Millisecond
	maxBackoff := 8 * time.Second

	for {
		c.mu.Lock()
		if c.closed {
			c.mu.Unlock()
			return
		}
		c.mu.Unlock()

		jitter := time.Duration(rand.Int63n(int64(250 * time.Millisecond)))
		sleepDuration := backoff + jitter
		if sleepDuration > maxBackoff {
			sleepDuration = maxBackoff
		}

		select {
		case <-c.reconnectCtx.Done():
			return
		case <-time.After(sleepDuration):
		}

		if err := c.connect(); err == nil {
			return
		}

		backoff *= 2
		if backoff > maxBackoff {
			backoff = maxBackoff
		}
	}
}

func (c *Client) writeLoop() {
	pingTicker := time.NewTicker(20 * time.Second)
	defer pingTicker.Stop()

	for {
		select {
		case <-c.reconnectCtx.Done():
			return
		case msg := <-c.sendQueue:
			c.mu.Lock()
			conn := c.conn
			c.mu.Unlock()
			if conn != nil {
				c.writeMu.Lock()
				_ = conn.SetWriteDeadline(time.Now().Add(5 * time.Second))
				_ = conn.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, msg)
				c.writeMu.Unlock()
			}
		case <-pingTicker.C:
			c.mu.Lock()
			conn := c.conn
			c.mu.Unlock()
			if conn != nil {
				c.writeMu.Lock()
				_ = conn.SetWriteDeadline(time.Now().Add(5 * time.Second))
				_ = conn.WriteMessage(websocket.PingMessage, nil)
				c.writeMu.Unlock()
			}
		}
	}
}

// Send sends an envelope to the signaling server.
func (c *Client) Send(env protocol.Envelope) error {
	c.mu.Lock()
	if c.closed {
		c.mu.Unlock()
		return errors.New("signaling client closed")
	}
	c.mu.Unlock()

	data, err := json.Marshal(env)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	select {
	case c.sendQueue <- data:
		return nil
	default:
		return errors.New("send queue full")
	}
}

// Close closes the signaling connection.
func (c *Client) Close() error {
	c.mu.Lock()
	if c.closed {
		c.mu.Unlock()
		return nil
	}
	c.closed = true
	c.cancel()
	conn := c.conn
	c.conn = nil
	c.mu.Unlock()

	if conn != nil {
		c.writeMu.Lock()
		_ = conn.Close()
		c.writeMu.Unlock()
	}
	return nil
}

// URL returns the WebSocket URL the client connects to.
func (c *Client) URL() string {
	return c.url
}

// QueryPeers requests the current list of online node IDs from the coordinator.
func (c *Client) QueryPeers(ctx context.Context) ([]string, error) {
	// First attempt via HTTP /api/nodes if reachable
	httpURL := c.url
	if strings.HasPrefix(httpURL, "ws://") {
		httpURL = "http://" + strings.TrimPrefix(httpURL, "ws://")
	} else if strings.HasPrefix(httpURL, "wss://") {
		httpURL = "https://" + strings.TrimPrefix(httpURL, "wss://")
	}
	httpURL = strings.TrimSuffix(httpURL, "/ws")

	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, "GET", httpURL+"/api/nodes", nil)
	if err == nil {
		if c.authToken != "" {
			req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+c.authToken)
		}
		client := &http.Client{Timeout: 3 * time.Second}
		resp, err := client.Do(req)
		if err == nil {
			defer resp.Body.Close()
			if resp.StatusCode == http.StatusOK {
				var result struct {
					Count int      `json:"count"`
					Nodes []string `json:"nodes"`
				}
				if err := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&result); err == nil {
					return result.Nodes, nil
				}
			}
		}
	}

	// Also request via WebSocket peer_list_req
	_ = c.Send(protocol.Envelope{
		Type:     protocol.MsgPeerListRequest,
		SenderID: c.nodeID,
		TargetID: "coordinator",
	})

	return nil, nil
}

package signaling

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/unicompute/obj1/pkg/protocol"
)

func TestSignaling_HubAndClientDispatch(t *testing.T) {
	hub, err := NewHub("127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("failed to start hub: %v", err)
	}
	defer hub.Close()

	wsURL := hub.URL()

	recvA := make(chan protocol.Envelope, 10)
	recvB := make(chan protocol.Envelope, 10)

	clientA, err := NewClient(wsURL, "node-A", func(env protocol.Envelope) {
		if env.Type != protocol.MsgRegisterAck {
			recvA <- env
		}
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("failed to create clientA: %v", err)
	}
	defer clientA.Close()

	clientB, err := NewClient(wsURL, "node-B", func(env protocol.Envelope) {
		if env.Type != protocol.MsgRegisterAck {
			recvB <- env
		}
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("failed to create clientB: %v", err)
	}
	defer clientB.Close()

	// Wait for registration
	time.Sleep(100 * time.Millisecond)

	// Send message from A to B
	payload, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]string{"greeting": "hello node-B"})
	env := protocol.Envelope{
		Type:     protocol.MsgSDPOffer,
		SenderID: "node-A",
		TargetID: "node-B",
		Payload:  payload,
	}

	if err := clientA.Send(env); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("clientA Send failed: %v", err)
	}

	select {
	case received := <-recvB:
		if received.Type != protocol.MsgSDPOffer {
			t.Errorf("expected MsgSDPOffer, got %v", received.Type)
		}
		if received.SenderID != "node-A" {
			t.Errorf("expected sender node-A, got %v", received.SenderID)
		}
	case <-time.After(2 * time.Second):
		t.Fatalf("timed out waiting for message at clientB")
	}
}

func TestSignaling_AuthTokenEnforcement(t *testing.T) {
	authToken := "test-secret-token-12345"
	hub, err := NewHub("127.0.0.1:0", authToken)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("failed to start hub: %v", err)
	}
	defer hub.Close()

	wsURL := hub.URL()

	// 1. Connection without token must fail
	_, err = NewClient(wsURL, "node-unauth", func(env protocol.Envelope) {})
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected NewClient without token to fail against protected hub")
	}

	// 2. Connection with wrong token must fail
	_, err = NewClient(wsURL, "node-wrong", func(env protocol.Envelope) {}, "wrong-token")
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected NewClient with wrong token to fail against protected hub")
	}

	// 3. Connection with valid token must succeed
	clientAuth, err := NewClient(wsURL, "node-valid", func(env protocol.Envelope) {}, authToken)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected NewClient with valid token to succeed, got: %v", err)
	}
	defer clientAuth.Close()
}

func TestSignaling_DuplicateNodeIDRejected(t *testing.T) {
	hub, err := NewHub("127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("failed to start hub: %v", err)
	}
	defer hub.Close()

	wsURL := hub.URL()

	// First client registers "node-alpha"
	c1, err := NewClient(wsURL, "node-alpha", func(env protocol.Envelope) {})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("failed to create c1: %v", err)
	}
	defer c1.Close()

	time.Sleep(100 * time.Millisecond)

	// Second client attempts to register "node-alpha"
	c2Ack := make(chan protocol.Envelope, 5)
	c2, err := NewClient(wsURL, "node-alpha", func(env protocol.Envelope) {
		if env.Type == protocol.MsgRegisterAck {
			c2Ack <- env
		}
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("failed to create c2: %v", err)
	}
	defer c2.Close()

	select {
	case ack := <-c2Ack:
		if !strings.Contains(string(ack.Payload), "duplicate nodeID registration rejected") {
			t.Errorf("expected duplicate registration rejection error, got payload: %s", string(ack.Payload))
		}
	case <-time.After(2 * time.Second):
		t.Fatalf("timed out waiting for duplicate rejection ack")
	}
}

package transport

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/binary"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/pion/webrtc/v3"
	"github.com/unicompute/obj1/pkg/instrumentation"
	"github.com/unicompute/obj1/pkg/protocol"
)

var (
	ErrConnectionClosed = errors.New("peer connection closed")
	ErrTimeout          = errors.New("connection timeout")
	ErrChannelNotReady  = errors.New("data channel not ready")
)

// Config configures the WebRTC transport engine.
type Config struct {
	NodeID          string
	STUNServers     []string
	TURNServers     []TURNServerConfig
	FallbackTimeout time.Duration // Fallback ladder timeout (default 2.0s as per spec)
	EnableLogging   bool
}

// TURNServerConfig holds WebRTC TURN server details.
type TURNServerConfig struct {
	URL        string
	Username   string
	Credential string
}

// PeerConnection wraps Pion WebRTC connection with dual-channel and path instrumentation.
type PeerConnection struct {
	mu           sync.RWMutex
	SessionID    string
	LocalPeerID  string
	RemotePeerID string
	PC           *webrtc.PeerConnection

	StreamDC *webrtc.DataChannel
	ChunkDC  *webrtc.DataChannel

	streamReady chan struct{}
	chunkReady  chan struct{}
	connectedCh chan struct{}
	connected   bool
	closed      bool

	// Event callbacks
	OnChunkReceived func(chunkID string, data []byte)
	OnStreamMessage func(msg []byte)
	OnChunkRequest  func(chunkID string)
	OnStateChange   func(state webrtc.PeerConnectionState)

	onInternalStateChange func(state webrtc.PeerConnectionState)

	// Instrumentation
	metrics   *instrumentation.PathMetrics
	tracker   *instrumentation.Tracker
	stopKeep  chan struct{}
	keepAlive *time.Ticker

	// In-flight chunk transfers: map[chunkID]*inFlightChunk
	inFlightMu sync.Mutex
	inFlight   map[string]*inFlightChunk
}

type inFlightChunk struct {
	chunkID   string
	totalSize uint64
	received  uint64
	data      []byte
	doneCh    chan []byte
	errCh     chan error
	hasWaiter bool
}

func newPeerConnection(sessionID, localPeerID, remotePeerID string, pc *webrtc.PeerConnection, tracker *instrumentation.Tracker) *PeerConnection {
	if sessionID == "" {
		sessionID = uuid.New().String()
	}

	conn := &PeerConnection{
		SessionID:    sessionID,
		LocalPeerID:  localPeerID,
		RemotePeerID: remotePeerID,
		PC:           pc,
		streamReady:  make(chan struct{}),
		chunkReady:   make(chan struct{}),
		connectedCh:  make(chan struct{}),
		stopKeep:     make(chan struct{}),
		tracker:      tracker,
		inFlight:     make(map[string]*inFlightChunk),
		metrics: &instrumentation.PathMetrics{
			PeerID:      remotePeerID,
			ConnectedAt: time.Now(),
		},
	}

	return conn
}

func (c *PeerConnection) cleanupInFlight(err error) {
	c.inFlightMu.Lock()
	defer c.inFlightMu.Unlock()
	for id, inflight := range c.inFlight {
		select {
		case inflight.errCh <- err:
		default:
		}
		delete(c.inFlight, id)
	}
}

func (c *PeerConnection) setupHandlers() {
	c.PC.OnConnectionStateChange(func(state webrtc.PeerConnectionState) {
		c.mu.Lock()
		if state == webrtc.PeerConnectionStateConnected && !c.connected {
			c.connected = true
			c.inspectCandidatePair()
			close(c.connectedCh)
			go c.startKeepAlive()
		} else if state == webrtc.PeerConnectionStateClosed || state == webrtc.PeerConnectionStateFailed {
			c.closed = true
			select {
			case <-c.stopKeep:
			default:
				close(c.stopKeep)
			}
			go c.cleanupInFlight(ErrConnectionClosed)
		}
		handler := c.OnStateChange
		internalHandler := c.onInternalStateChange
		c.mu.Unlock()

		if internalHandler != nil {
			internalHandler(state)
		}
		if handler != nil {
			handler(state)
		}
	})
}

// SetOnChunkReceived safely sets the chunk received callback.
func (c *PeerConnection) SetOnChunkReceived(fn func(chunkID string, data []byte)) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	c.OnChunkReceived = fn
	c.mu.Unlock()
}

// SetOnChunkRequest safely sets the chunk request callback.
func (c *PeerConnection) SetOnChunkRequest(fn func(chunkID string)) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	c.OnChunkRequest = fn
	c.mu.Unlock()
}

// SetOnStreamMessage safely sets the stream message callback.
func (c *PeerConnection) SetOnStreamMessage(fn func(msg []byte)) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	c.OnStreamMessage = fn
	c.mu.Unlock()
}

// SetOnStateChange safely sets the state change callback.
func (c *PeerConnection) SetOnStateChange(fn func(state webrtc.PeerConnectionState)) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	c.OnStateChange = fn
	c.mu.Unlock()
}

// setOnInternalStateChange safely sets the internal state change callback.
func (c *PeerConnection) setOnInternalStateChange(fn func(state webrtc.PeerConnectionState)) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	c.onInternalStateChange = fn
	c.mu.Unlock()
}

// inspectCandidatePair inspects the selected ICE candidate pair to determine direct vs relayed
// and measures connection parameters.
func (c *PeerConnection) inspectCandidatePair() {
	sctp := c.PC.SCTP()
	if sctp == nil || sctp.Transport() == nil || sctp.Transport().ICETransport() == nil {
		return
	}

	iceTransport := sctp.Transport().ICETransport()
	pair, err := iceTransport.GetSelectedCandidatePair()
	if err == nil && pair != nil {
		localType := pair.Local.Typ.String()
		remoteType := pair.Remote.Typ.String()

		pairType, isDirect := instrumentation.DetermineCandidatePairType(localType, remoteType)
		c.metrics.IsDirect = isDirect
		c.metrics.IsRelayed = !isDirect
		c.metrics.PairType = pairType
		c.metrics.LocalCandidate = fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d (%s)", pair.Local.Address, pair.Local.Port, pair.Local.Typ)
		c.metrics.RemoteCandidate = fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d (%s)", pair.Remote.Address, pair.Remote.Port, pair.Remote.Typ)

		if c.tracker != nil {
			c.tracker.RecordConnection(c.metrics)
		}
	}
}

// startKeepAlive sends periodic ping binding frames every 15 seconds to prevent NAT timeouts.
func (c *PeerConnection) startKeepAlive() {
	ticker := time.NewTicker(15 * time.Second) // 15s keepalive as specified in Section 5 & 6.1
	defer ticker.Stop()

	for {
		select {
		case <-c.stopKeep:
			return
		case <-ticker.C:
			c.mu.RLock()
			dc := c.ChunkDC
			c.mu.RUnlock()
			if dc != nil && dc.ReadyState() == webrtc.DataChannelStateOpen {
				pingFrame := []byte{protocol.DataMsgKeepalive}
				_ = dc.Send(pingFrame)
			}
		}
	}
}

// bindDataChannel hooks message handlers and readiness channels for a DataChannel.
func (c *PeerConnection) bindDataChannel(dc *webrtc.DataChannel) {
	label := dc.Label()
	dc.OnOpen(func() {
		if label == "stream" {
			c.mu.Lock()
			c.StreamDC = dc
			c.mu.Unlock()
			select {
			case <-c.streamReady:
			default:
				close(c.streamReady)
			}
		} else if label == "chunk" {
			c.mu.Lock()
			c.ChunkDC = dc
			c.mu.Unlock()
			select {
			case <-c.chunkReady:
			default:
				close(c.chunkReady)
			}
		}
	})

	dc.OnClose(func() {
		c.mu.Lock()
		internalHandler := c.onInternalStateChange
		c.mu.Unlock()
		if internalHandler != nil {
			internalHandler(webrtc.PeerConnectionStateClosed)
		}
	})

	dc.OnMessage(func(msg webrtc.DataChannelMessage) {
		data := msg.Data
		if len(data) == 0 {
			return
		}

		if c.tracker != nil {
			c.tracker.RecordDataTransfer(c.RemotePeerID, 0, int64(len(data)))
		}

		if label == "stream" {
			c.mu.RLock()
			handler := c.OnStreamMessage
			c.mu.RUnlock()
			if handler != nil {
				handler(data)
			}
			return
		}

		// Chunk channel message handling
		c.handleChunkMessage(data)
	})
}

func (c *PeerConnection) handleChunkMessage(data []byte) {
	if len(data) == 0 {
		return
	}

	msgType := data[0]

	switch msgType {
	case protocol.DataMsgKeepalive:
		// Keepalive ping received; no-op or ack
		return

	case protocol.DataMsgChunkResponse:
		if len(data) < protocol.ChunkHeaderSize {
			return
		}

		flags := data[1]
		offset := binary.BigEndian.Uint64(data[2:10])
		totalSize := binary.BigEndian.Uint64(data[10:18])
		rawID := string(data[18:82])
		chunkID := strings.TrimRight(rawID, "\x00")
		payload := data[protocol.ChunkHeaderSize:]

		const MaxAllowedChunkSize uint64 = 64 * 1024 * 1024
		if totalSize > MaxAllowedChunkSize {
			return
		}

		c.inFlightMu.Lock()
		inflight, ok := c.inFlight[chunkID]
		if !ok && (flags&protocol.FlagStart != 0) {
			inflight = &inFlightChunk{
				chunkID:   chunkID,
				totalSize: totalSize,
				data:      make([]byte, totalSize),
				doneCh:    make(chan []byte, 1),
				errCh:     make(chan error, 1),
			}
			c.inFlight[chunkID] = inflight
		} else if ok && len(inflight.data) == 0 {
			inflight.totalSize = totalSize
			inflight.data = make([]byte, totalSize)
		}
		c.inFlightMu.Unlock()

		if inflight == nil {
			return
		}

		if offset+uint64(len(payload)) <= uint64(len(inflight.data)) {
			copy(inflight.data[offset:], payload)
			atomic.AddUint64(&inflight.received, uint64(len(payload)))
		}

		if (flags&protocol.FlagEnd != 0) || (atomic.LoadUint64(&inflight.received) >= inflight.totalSize) {
			c.inFlightMu.Lock()
			delete(c.inFlight, chunkID)
			hadWaiter := inflight.hasWaiter
			c.inFlightMu.Unlock()

			select {
			case inflight.doneCh <- inflight.data:
			default:
			}

			if !hadWaiter {
				c.mu.RLock()
				handler := c.OnChunkReceived
				c.mu.RUnlock()
				if handler != nil {
					handler(chunkID, inflight.data)
				}
			}
		}

	case protocol.DataMsgChunkRequest:
		if len(data) >= 2 {
			idLen := int(data[1])
			if len(data) >= 2+idLen {
				reqID := string(data[2 : 2+idLen])
				c.mu.RLock()
				handler := c.OnChunkRequest
				c.mu.RUnlock()
				if handler != nil {
					go handler(reqID)
				}
			}
		}

	case protocol.DataMsgChunkError:
		if len(data) >= 2 {
			idLen := int(data[1])
			if len(data) >= 2+idLen {
				chunkID := string(data[2 : 2+idLen])
				errMsg := string(data[2+idLen:])
				c.inFlightMu.Lock()
				inflight, ok := c.inFlight[chunkID]
				if ok {
					delete(c.inFlight, chunkID)
				}
				c.inFlightMu.Unlock()
				if ok && inflight != nil {
					select {
					case inflight.errCh <- errors.New(errMsg):
					default:
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

// SendChunk streams chunk bytes in 64 KiB - 256 KiB frames over the reliable SCTP DataChannel.
func (c *PeerConnection) SendChunk(ctx context.Context, chunkID string, r io.Reader, totalSize int64) error {
	c.mu.RLock()
	dc := c.ChunkDC
	c.mu.RUnlock()

	if dc == nil || dc.ReadyState() != webrtc.DataChannelStateOpen {
		return ErrChannelNotReady
	}

	// 64-byte padded chunkID (e.g. SHA-256 hex string)
	idBytes := make([]byte, 64)
	copy(idBytes, []byte(chunkID))

	// Handle 0-byte chunk transfer
	if totalSize == 0 {
		frame := make([]byte, protocol.ChunkHeaderSize)
		frame[0] = protocol.DataMsgChunkResponse
		frame[1] = protocol.FlagStart | protocol.FlagEnd
		binary.BigEndian.PutUint64(frame[2:10], 0)
		binary.BigEndian.PutUint64(frame[10:18], 0)
		copy(frame[18:82], idBytes)

		if err := dc.Send(frame); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("failed to send chunk frame: %w", err)
		}
		if c.tracker != nil {
			c.tracker.RecordDataTransfer(c.RemotePeerID, int64(len(frame)), 0)
		}
		return nil
	}

	// Frame payload size: 60 KiB to stay safely within SCTP frame limits with ChunkHeaderSize (PDF Section 6.3)
	framePayloadSize := 60 * 1024
	buf := make([]byte, framePayloadSize)
	offset := uint64(0)

	for {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return ctx.Err()
		default:
		}

		nr, readErr := r.Read(buf)
		if nr > 0 {
			var flags byte = protocol.FlagData
			if offset == 0 {
				flags |= protocol.FlagStart
			}
			if offset+uint64(nr) >= uint64(totalSize) || readErr == io.EOF {
				flags |= protocol.FlagEnd
			}

			frame := make([]byte, protocol.ChunkHeaderSize+nr)
			frame[0] = protocol.DataMsgChunkResponse
			frame[1] = flags
			binary.BigEndian.PutUint64(frame[2:10], offset)
			binary.BigEndian.PutUint64(frame[10:18], uint64(totalSize))
			copy(frame[18:82], idBytes)
			copy(frame[protocol.ChunkHeaderSize:], buf[:nr])

			// Backpressure: wait if SCTP send buffer exceeds threshold (e.g. 4 MiB)
			for dc.BufferedAmount() > 4*1024*1024 {
				select {
				case <-ctx.Done():
					return ctx.Err()
				case <-time.After(5 * time.Millisecond):
				}
				c.mu.RLock()
				closed := c.closed
				c.mu.RUnlock()
				if closed {
					return ErrConnectionClosed
				}
			}

			if err := dc.Send(frame); err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("failed to send chunk frame: %w", err)
			}

			if c.tracker != nil {
				c.tracker.RecordDataTransfer(c.RemotePeerID, int64(len(frame)), 0)
			}

			offset += uint64(nr)
		}

		if readErr == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if readErr != nil {
			return readErr
		}
	}

	return nil
}

// RequestChunk transmits a DataMsgChunkRequest (0x10) frame over ChunkDC.
func (c *PeerConnection) RequestChunk(chunkID string) error {
	c.mu.RLock()
	dc := c.ChunkDC
	c.mu.RUnlock()

	if dc == nil || dc.ReadyState() != webrtc.DataChannelStateOpen {
		return ErrChannelNotReady
	}

	idBytes := []byte(chunkID)
	if len(idBytes) > 255 {
		return fmt.Errorf("chunkID too long: %d", len(idBytes))
	}

	frame := make([]byte, 2+len(idBytes))
	frame[0] = protocol.DataMsgChunkRequest
	frame[1] = byte(len(idBytes))
	copy(frame[2:], idBytes)
	return dc.Send(frame)
}

// SendChunkError transmits a DataMsgChunkError (0x14) frame over ChunkDC.
func (c *PeerConnection) SendChunkError(chunkID string, errMsg string) error {
	c.mu.RLock()
	dc := c.ChunkDC
	c.mu.RUnlock()

	if dc == nil || dc.ReadyState() != webrtc.DataChannelStateOpen {
		return ErrChannelNotReady
	}

	idBytes := []byte(chunkID)
	if len(idBytes) > 255 {
		idBytes = idBytes[:255]
	}
	errBytes := []byte(errMsg)
	frame := make([]byte, 2+len(idBytes)+len(errBytes))
	frame[0] = protocol.DataMsgChunkError
	frame[1] = byte(len(idBytes))
	copy(frame[2:2+len(idBytes)], idBytes)
	copy(frame[2+len(idBytes):], errBytes)
	return dc.Send(frame)
}

// FetchChunk registers an in-flight expectation, transmits a chunk request (0x10),
// and waits for chunk completion, error frame, or context cancellation.
func (c *PeerConnection) FetchChunk(ctx context.Context, chunkID string, totalSize int64) ([]byte, error) {
	const MaxAllowedChunkSize int64 = 64 * 1024 * 1024
	if totalSize < 0 || totalSize > MaxAllowedChunkSize {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid chunk size: %d", totalSize)
	}

	c.inFlightMu.Lock()
	inflight, ok := c.inFlight[chunkID]
	if !ok {
		var buf []byte
		if totalSize > 0 {
			buf = make([]byte, totalSize)
		}
		inflight = &inFlightChunk{
			chunkID:   chunkID,
			totalSize: uint64(totalSize),
			data:      buf,
			doneCh:    make(chan []byte, 1),
			errCh:     make(chan error, 1),
			hasWaiter: true,
		}
		c.inFlight[chunkID] = inflight
	} else {
		inflight.hasWaiter = true
	}
	c.inFlightMu.Unlock()

	defer func() {
		c.inFlightMu.Lock()
		delete(c.inFlight, chunkID)
		c.inFlightMu.Unlock()
	}()

	if err := c.RequestChunk(chunkID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	select {
	case data := <-inflight.doneCh:
		return data, nil
	case err := <-inflight.errCh:
		return nil, err
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return nil, ctx.Err()
	}
}

// ReceiveChunk registers an in-flight expectation and blocks until full chunk bytes are received.
func (c *PeerConnection) ReceiveChunk(ctx context.Context, chunkID string, totalSize int64) ([]byte, error) {
	const MaxAllowedChunkSize int64 = 64 * 1024 * 1024
	if totalSize < 0 || totalSize > MaxAllowedChunkSize {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid chunk size: %d", totalSize)
	}

	c.inFlightMu.Lock()
	inflight, ok := c.inFlight[chunkID]
	if !ok {
		var buf []byte
		if totalSize > 0 {
			buf = make([]byte, totalSize)
		}
		inflight = &inFlightChunk{
			chunkID:   chunkID,
			totalSize: uint64(totalSize),
			data:      buf,
			doneCh:    make(chan []byte, 1),
			errCh:     make(chan error, 1),
			hasWaiter: true,
		}
		c.inFlight[chunkID] = inflight
	} else {
		inflight.hasWaiter = true
	}
	c.inFlightMu.Unlock()

	defer func() {
		c.inFlightMu.Lock()
		delete(c.inFlight, chunkID)
		c.inFlightMu.Unlock()
	}()

	select {
	case data := <-inflight.doneCh:
		return data, nil
	case err := <-inflight.errCh:
		return nil, err
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return nil, ctx.Err()
	}
}

// SendStreamMessage sends a low-latency message across the stream DataChannel.
func (c *PeerConnection) SendStreamMessage(msg []byte) error {
	c.mu.RLock()
	dc := c.StreamDC
	c.mu.RUnlock()

	if dc == nil || dc.ReadyState() != webrtc.DataChannelStateOpen {
		return ErrChannelNotReady
	}
	return dc.Send(msg)
}

// WaitConnected waits until WebRTC peer connection reaches Connected state.
func (c *PeerConnection) WaitConnected(ctx context.Context) error {
	c.mu.RLock()
	if c.connected {
		c.mu.RUnlock()
		return nil
	}
	c.mu.RUnlock()

	select {
	case <-c.connectedCh:
		return nil
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return ctx.Err()
	}
}

// WaitChannelsReady waits until both Stream and Chunk DataChannels are open.
func (c *PeerConnection) WaitChannelsReady(ctx context.Context) error {
	select {
	case <-c.streamReady:
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return ctx.Err()
	}

	select {
	case <-c.chunkReady:
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return ctx.Err()
	}

	return nil
}

// Close terminates the peer connection.
func (c *PeerConnection) Close() error {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()

	if c.closed {
		return nil
	}
	c.closed = true

	select {
	case <-c.stopKeep:
	default:
		close(c.stopKeep)
	}

	if c.StreamDC != nil {
		_ = c.StreamDC.Close()
	}
	if c.ChunkDC != nil {
		_ = c.ChunkDC.Close()
	}
	c.cleanupInFlight(ErrConnectionClosed)
	if c.PC != nil {
		return c.PC.Close()
	}
	return nil
}

package transport

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/pion/webrtc/v3"
	"github.com/unicompute/obj1/pkg/instrumentation"
	"github.com/unicompute/obj1/pkg/nat"
	"github.com/unicompute/obj1/pkg/protocol"
	"github.com/unicompute/obj1/pkg/signaling"
)

// Manager manages WebRTC API lifecycle, peer connection establishment,
// and signaling coordination.
type Manager struct {
	mu           sync.Mutex
	cfg          Config
	api          *webrtc.API
	sigClient    *signaling.Client
	tracker      *instrumentation.Tracker
	connections  map[string]*PeerConnection // sessionID -> PeerConnection
	peerSessions map[string]string          // remotePeerID -> sessionID
	onNewConn    func(*PeerConnection)
	closed       bool
}

// NewManager creates a new WebRTC transport manager with PDF-specified engine tuning.
func NewManager(cfg Config, sigClient *signaling.Client, tracker *instrumentation.Tracker) (*Manager, error) {
	if cfg.FallbackTimeout == 0 {
		cfg.FallbackTimeout = 2000 * time.Millisecond // 2.0s Fast Fallback ceiling (PDF Section 5)
	}

	settingEngine := webrtc.SettingEngine{}

	// Fix 1: SCTP receive buffer at 16 MiB (PDF Section 6.3)
	settingEngine.SetSCTPMaxReceiveBufferSize(16 * 1024 * 1024)

	// Section 6.3 note: In Pion v3, SCTP transport defaults to 64 KB message size;
	// chunk streaming frames are segmented at 60 KiB in SendChunk to prevent truncation.

	// Fix 3: 15-second keepalive intervals to prevent home router NAT mapping timeouts (PDF Section 5 & 6.1)
	settingEngine.SetICETimeouts(20*time.Second, 25*time.Second, 15*time.Second)

	// Fix 4: Host candidates from virtual adapters pruned via SetInterfaceFilter (PDF Section 6.3)
	settingEngine.SetInterfaceFilter(nat.InterfaceFilter())

	// Setting up the API
	api := webrtc.NewAPI(webrtc.WithSettingEngine(settingEngine))

	if tracker == nil {
		tracker = instrumentation.NewTracker()
	}

	m := &Manager{
		cfg:          cfg,
		api:          api,
		sigClient:    sigClient,
		tracker:      tracker,
		connections:  make(map[string]*PeerConnection),
		peerSessions: make(map[string]string),
	}

	return m, nil
}

// SetOnNewConnection sets the handler for incoming peer connections.
func (m *Manager) SetOnNewConnection(fn func(*PeerConnection)) {
	m.mu.Lock()
	m.onNewConn = fn
	m.mu.Unlock()
}

// GetTracker returns the connection telemetry tracker.
func (m *Manager) GetTracker() *instrumentation.Tracker {
	return m.tracker
}

func (m *Manager) removeSession(peerID, sessionID string) {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	if cur, ok := m.peerSessions[peerID]; ok && cur == sessionID {
		delete(m.peerSessions, peerID)
	}
	delete(m.connections, sessionID)
}

func (m *Manager) getSignalingClient() *signaling.Client {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	return m.sigClient
}

// formatICEURL formats and normalizes STUN/TURN URLs to standard RFC 7064/7065 URI schemes
// (e.g., stun:host:port, turn:host:port), resolving missing schemes, trimming double-slash syntax,
// bracketing IPv6 literals, and handling query parameters.
func formatICEURL(rawURL string, defaultScheme string) string {
	rawURL = strings.TrimSpace(rawURL)
	if rawURL == "" {
		return ""
	}

	scheme := strings.TrimSuffix(strings.ToLower(defaultScheme), ":")
	rest := rawURL

	lower := strings.ToLower(rawURL)
	switch {
	case strings.HasPrefix(lower, "stun://"):
		scheme = "stun"
		rest = rawURL[7:]
	case strings.HasPrefix(lower, "stuns://"):
		scheme = "stuns"
		rest = rawURL[8:]
	case strings.HasPrefix(lower, "turn://"):
		scheme = "turn"
		rest = rawURL[7:]
	case strings.HasPrefix(lower, "turns://"):
		scheme = "turns"
		rest = rawURL[8:]
	case strings.HasPrefix(lower, "stun:"):
		scheme = "stun"
		rest = rawURL[5:]
	case strings.HasPrefix(lower, "stuns:"):
		scheme = "stuns"
		rest = rawURL[6:]
	case strings.HasPrefix(lower, "turn:"):
		scheme = "turn"
		rest = rawURL[5:]
	case strings.HasPrefix(lower, "turns:"):
		scheme = "turns"
		rest = rawURL[6:]
	default:
		if strings.HasPrefix(rawURL, "//") {
			rest = rawURL[2:]
		}
	}

	rest = strings.TrimSpace(rest)
	if rest == "" {
		return ""
	}

	// Extract query parameter if present (e.g., ?transport=tcp)
	var query string
	if qIdx := strings.Index(rest, "?"); qIdx != -1 {
		query = rest[qIdx:]
		rest = strings.TrimSpace(rest[:qIdx])
		if rest == "" {
			return ""
		}
	}

	// Normalize IPv6 literals to ensure proper bracketing required by RFC 7064/7065 and Pion
	if !strings.HasPrefix(rest, "[") {
		if ip := net.ParseIP(rest); ip != nil && strings.Contains(rest, ":") {
			// Unbracketed IPv6 without port (e.g., 2001:db8::1 or ::1)
			rest = "[" + rest + "]"
		} else if lastColon := strings.LastIndex(rest, ":"); lastColon != -1 {
			// Check for unbracketed IPv6 with port (e.g., 2001:db8::1:19302)
			possibleIP := rest[:lastColon]
			possiblePort := rest[lastColon+1:]
			if ip := net.ParseIP(possibleIP); ip != nil && strings.Contains(possibleIP, ":") {
				if _, err := strconv.Atoi(possiblePort); err == nil {
					rest = "[" + possibleIP + "]:" + possiblePort
				}
			}
		}
	}

	return scheme + ":" + rest + query
}

// buildICEServers converts config STUN and TURN entries to Pion ICEServers.
func (m *Manager) buildICEServers() []webrtc.ICEServer {
	var servers []webrtc.ICEServer

	if len(m.cfg.STUNServers) > 0 {
		var stunURLs []string
		for _, s := range m.cfg.STUNServers {
			for _, part := range strings.Split(s, ",") {
				formatted := formatICEURL(part, "stun")
				if formatted != "" {
					stunURLs = append(stunURLs, formatted)
				}
			}
		}
		if len(stunURLs) > 0 {
			servers = append(servers, webrtc.ICEServer{
				URLs: stunURLs,
			})
		}
	}

	for _, turn := range m.cfg.TURNServers {
		var turnURLs []string
		for _, part := range strings.Split(turn.URL, ",") {
			formatted := formatICEURL(part, "turn")
			if formatted != "" {
				turnURLs = append(turnURLs, formatted)
			}
		}
		if len(turnURLs) > 0 {
			servers = append(servers, webrtc.ICEServer{
				URLs:       turnURLs,
				Username:   turn.Username,
				Credential: turn.Credential,
			})
		}
	}

	return servers
}

// ConnectPeer initiates an outbound connection to a target peer using Trickle ICE.
func (m *Manager) ConnectPeer(ctx context.Context, targetPeerID string) (*PeerConnection, error) {
	sessionID := uuid.New().String()

	webrtcCfg := webrtc.Configuration{
		ICEServers: m.buildICEServers(),
	}

	pc, err := m.api.NewPeerConnection(webrtcCfg)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create PeerConnection: %w", err)
	}

	conn := newPeerConnection(sessionID, m.cfg.NodeID, targetPeerID, pc, m.tracker)
	conn.setupHandlers()

	m.mu.Lock()
	if oldSessionID, exists := m.peerSessions[targetPeerID]; exists && oldSessionID != sessionID {
		if oldConn, ok := m.connections[oldSessionID]; ok {
			delete(m.connections, oldSessionID)
			go func(c *PeerConnection) {
				_ = c.Close()
			}(oldConn)
		}
	}
	m.connections[sessionID] = conn
	m.peerSessions[targetPeerID] = sessionID
	onConnHandler := m.onNewConn
	m.mu.Unlock()

	conn.setOnInternalStateChange(func(state webrtc.PeerConnectionState) {
		if state == webrtc.PeerConnectionStateFailed || state == webrtc.PeerConnectionStateClosed || state == webrtc.PeerConnectionStateDisconnected {
			m.removeSession(targetPeerID, sessionID)
		}
	})

	// Register event callbacks (storage, streams) before creating DataChannels and Offer
	if onConnHandler != nil {
		onConnHandler(conn)
	}

	// ICE Candidate gathering & Trickle signaling
	pc.OnICECandidate(func(c *webrtc.ICECandidate) {
		sig := m.getSignalingClient()
		if c == nil || sig == nil {
			return
		}
		candidateJSON := c.ToJSON()
		payload := protocol.ICECandidatePayload{
			SessionID: sessionID,
			Candidate: candidateJSON.Candidate,
		}
		if candidateJSON.SDPMid != nil {
			payload.SDPMid = *candidateJSON.SDPMid
		}
		if candidateJSON.SDPMLineIndex != nil {
			payload.SDPMLineIndex = *candidateJSON.SDPMLineIndex
		}

		rawPayload, _ := json.Marshal(payload)
		_ = sig.Send(protocol.Envelope{
			Type:     protocol.MsgICECandidate,
			SenderID: m.cfg.NodeID,
			TargetID: targetPeerID,
			Payload:  rawPayload,
		})
	})

	// Create Dual DataChannels:
	// Channel A: "stream" is reliable because it carries control and job messages.
	streamDC, err := pc.CreateDataChannel("stream", &webrtc.DataChannelInit{
		Ordered: func(b bool) *bool { return &b }(true),
	})
	if err != nil {
		m.removeSession(targetPeerID, sessionID)
		_ = conn.Close()
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create stream DataChannel: %w", err)
	}
	conn.bindDataChannel(streamDC)

	// Channel B: "chunk" (ordered, reliable, no packet loss)
	chunkDC, err := pc.CreateDataChannel("chunk", &webrtc.DataChannelInit{
		Ordered: func(b bool) *bool { return &b }(true),
	})
	if err != nil {
		m.removeSession(targetPeerID, sessionID)
		_ = conn.Close()
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create chunk DataChannel: %w", err)
	}
	conn.bindDataChannel(chunkDC)

	// Create SDP Offer
	offer, err := pc.CreateOffer(nil)
	if err != nil {
		m.removeSession(targetPeerID, sessionID)
		_ = conn.Close()
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create offer: %w", err)
	}

	if err := pc.SetLocalDescription(offer); err != nil {
		m.removeSession(targetPeerID, sessionID)
		_ = conn.Close()
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to set local description: %w", err)
	}

	// Transmit Offer via signaling
	if sig := m.getSignalingClient(); sig != nil {
		sdpPayload, _ := json.Marshal(protocol.SDPPayload{
			SessionID: sessionID,
			Type:      offer.Type.String(),
			SDP:       offer.SDP,
		})
		_ = sig.Send(protocol.Envelope{
			Type:     protocol.MsgSDPOffer,
			SenderID: m.cfg.NodeID,
			TargetID: targetPeerID,
			Payload:  sdpPayload,
		})
	}

	// Fast Fallback Ladder wait with context
	fallbackCtx, cancelFallback := context.WithTimeout(ctx, m.FallbackTimeout())
	defer cancelFallback()

	connErr := conn.WaitConnected(fallbackCtx)
	if connErr != nil {
		// If timeout reached before direct connection converged, connection can either
		// continue waiting or activate relay fallback
		if errors.Is(connErr, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
			// Wait on overall context if direct connection is still progressing
			connErr = conn.WaitConnected(ctx)
		}
		if connErr != nil {
			m.removeSession(targetPeerID, sessionID)
			_ = conn.Close()
			return nil, connErr
		}
	}

	if err := conn.WaitChannelsReady(ctx); err != nil {
		m.removeSession(targetPeerID, sessionID)
		_ = conn.Close()
		return nil, err
	}

	return conn, nil
}

// HandleSignalingEnvelope processes incoming signaling messages.
func (m *Manager) HandleSignalingEnvelope(env protocol.Envelope) error {
	switch env.Type {
	case protocol.MsgSDPOffer:
		var sdp protocol.SDPPayload
		if err := json.Unmarshal(env.Payload, &sdp); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return m.handleOffer(env.SenderID, sdp)

	case protocol.MsgSDPAnswer:
		var sdp protocol.SDPPayload
		if err := json.Unmarshal(env.Payload, &sdp); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return m.handleAnswer(sdp)

	case protocol.MsgICECandidate:
		var cand protocol.ICECandidatePayload
		if err := json.Unmarshal(env.Payload, &cand); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return m.handleCandidate(cand)
	}

	return nil
}

func (m *Manager) handleOffer(remotePeerID string, sdp protocol.SDPPayload) error {
	webrtcCfg := webrtc.Configuration{
		ICEServers: m.buildICEServers(),
	}

	pc, err := m.api.NewPeerConnection(webrtcCfg)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	conn := newPeerConnection(sdp.SessionID, m.cfg.NodeID, remotePeerID, pc, m.tracker)
	conn.setupHandlers()

	m.mu.Lock()
	if oldSessionID, exists := m.peerSessions[remotePeerID]; exists && oldSessionID != sdp.SessionID {
		if oldConn, ok := m.connections[oldSessionID]; ok {
			delete(m.connections, oldSessionID)
			go func(c *PeerConnection) {
				_ = c.Close()
			}(oldConn)
		}
	}
	m.connections[sdp.SessionID] = conn
	m.peerSessions[remotePeerID] = sdp.SessionID
	onConnHandler := m.onNewConn
	m.mu.Unlock()

	conn.setOnInternalStateChange(func(state webrtc.PeerConnectionState) {
		if state == webrtc.PeerConnectionStateFailed || state == webrtc.PeerConnectionStateClosed || state == webrtc.PeerConnectionStateDisconnected {
			m.removeSession(remotePeerID, sdp.SessionID)
		}
	})

	// Register event callbacks (storage, streams) synchronously before receiving early DataChannel messages
	if onConnHandler != nil {
		onConnHandler(conn)
	}

	// Answerer listens for DataChannels created by the offerer
	pc.OnDataChannel(func(dc *webrtc.DataChannel) {
		conn.bindDataChannel(dc)
	})

	// Trickle ICE candidates
	pc.OnICECandidate(func(c *webrtc.ICECandidate) {
		sig := m.getSignalingClient()
		if c == nil || sig == nil {
			return
		}
		candidateJSON := c.ToJSON()
		payload := protocol.ICECandidatePayload{
			SessionID: sdp.SessionID,
			Candidate: candidateJSON.Candidate,
		}
		if candidateJSON.SDPMid != nil {
			payload.SDPMid = *candidateJSON.SDPMid
		}
		if candidateJSON.SDPMLineIndex != nil {
			payload.SDPMLineIndex = *candidateJSON.SDPMLineIndex
		}

		rawPayload, _ := json.Marshal(payload)
		_ = sig.Send(protocol.Envelope{
			Type:     protocol.MsgICECandidate,
			SenderID: m.cfg.NodeID,
			TargetID: remotePeerID,
			Payload:  rawPayload,
		})
	})

	offer := webrtc.SessionDescription{
		Type: webrtc.SDPTypeOffer,
		SDP:  sdp.SDP,
	}

	if err := pc.SetRemoteDescription(offer); err != nil {
		m.removeSession(remotePeerID, sdp.SessionID)
		_ = conn.Close()
		return err
	}

	answer, err := pc.CreateAnswer(nil)
	if err != nil {
		m.removeSession(remotePeerID, sdp.SessionID)
		_ = conn.Close()
		return err
	}

	if err := pc.SetLocalDescription(answer); err != nil {
		m.removeSession(remotePeerID, sdp.SessionID)
		_ = conn.Close()
		return err
	}

	if sig := m.getSignalingClient(); sig != nil {
		answerPayload, _ := json.Marshal(protocol.SDPPayload{
			SessionID: sdp.SessionID,
			Type:      answer.Type.String(),
			SDP:       answer.SDP,
		})
		_ = sig.Send(protocol.Envelope{
			Type:     protocol.MsgSDPAnswer,
			SenderID: m.cfg.NodeID,
			TargetID: remotePeerID,
			Payload:  answerPayload,
		})
	}

	return nil
}

func (m *Manager) handleAnswer(sdp protocol.SDPPayload) error {
	m.mu.Lock()
	conn, ok := m.connections[sdp.SessionID]
	m.mu.Unlock()

	if !ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("unknown session: %s", sdp.SessionID)
	}

	answer := webrtc.SessionDescription{
		Type: webrtc.SDPTypeAnswer,
		SDP:  sdp.SDP,
	}

	return conn.PC.SetRemoteDescription(answer)
}

func (m *Manager) handleCandidate(cand protocol.ICECandidatePayload) error {
	m.mu.Lock()
	conn, ok := m.connections[cand.SessionID]
	m.mu.Unlock()

	if !ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("unknown session: %s", cand.SessionID)
	}

	init := webrtc.ICECandidateInit{
		Candidate:     cand.Candidate,
		SDPMid:        &cand.SDPMid,
		SDPMLineIndex: &cand.SDPMLineIndex,
	}

	return conn.PC.AddICECandidate(init)
}

// GetConnection returns an active connection to a remote peer.
func (m *Manager) GetConnection(peerID string) (*PeerConnection, bool) {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()

	sessionID, ok := m.peerSessions[peerID]
	if !ok {
		return nil, false
	}
	conn, ok := m.connections[sessionID]
	return conn, ok
}

// ActivePeers returns a slice of remote peer IDs that currently have a peer session.
func (m *Manager) ActivePeers() []string {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()

	peers := make([]string, 0, len(m.peerSessions))
	for peerID := range m.peerSessions {
		peers = append(peers, peerID)
	}
	return peers
}

// DisconnectPeer terminates the WebRTC connection to a specific peer.
func (m *Manager) DisconnectPeer(peerID string) error {
	m.mu.Lock()
	sessionID, ok := m.peerSessions[peerID]
	if !ok {
		m.mu.Unlock()
		return fmt.Errorf("no connection to peer %s", peerID)
	}
	conn, hasConn := m.connections[sessionID]
	delete(m.peerSessions, peerID)
	delete(m.connections, sessionID)
	m.mu.Unlock()

	if hasConn && conn != nil {
		return conn.Close()
	}
	return nil
}

// Close closes all peer connections and shuts down the transport manager.
func (m *Manager) Close() error {
	m.mu.Lock()
	if m.closed {
		m.mu.Unlock()
		return nil
	}
	m.closed = true

	for _, conn := range m.connections {
		_ = conn.Close()
	}
	m.connections = make(map[string]*PeerConnection)
	m.peerSessions = make(map[string]string)
	m.mu.Unlock()

	return nil
}

// SetSignalingClient dynamically updates the signaling client instance.
func (m *Manager) SetSignalingClient(sig *signaling.Client) {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	m.sigClient = sig
}

// SetFallbackTimeout dynamically updates the blind relay fallback timeout threshold.
func (m *Manager) SetFallbackTimeout(d time.Duration) {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	m.cfg.FallbackTimeout = d
}

// FallbackTimeout returns the active blind relay fallback timeout threshold.
func (m *Manager) FallbackTimeout() time.Duration {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	return m.cfg.FallbackTimeout
}
